def get_data( name: str | None = None, force_download: bool = False, version: int = 26, target_extension: str = '.csv') -> str | list[str] | None: 
 12def get_data(
 13    name: str | None = None,
 14    force_download: bool = False,
 15    version: int = 26,
 16    target_extension: str = ".csv",
 17) -> str | list[str] | None:
 18    """Get ANTsPyMM data filename.
 19
 20    The first time this is called, it will download data to ~/.antspymm.
 21    After, it will just read data from disk.
 22
 23    Arguments
 24    ---------
 25    name : string
 26        name of data tag to retrieve. Options: None, 'all', or specific tag stem.
 27    force_download : boolean
 28        Whether to re-download even if files exist.
 29    version : integer
 30        Version of data to download.
 31    target_extension : string
 32        Target file extension to filter by (default: '.csv').
 33
 34    Returns
 35    -------
 36    string or list of strings or None
 37        Filepath or list of filepaths of selected data.
 38    """
 39    os.makedirs(DATA_PATH, exist_ok=True)
 40
 41    def _mv_subfolder_files(folder: str, verbose: bool = False) -> None:
 42        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
 43            if verbose:
 44                print(f"Processing directory: {root}")
 45            for file in files:
 46                if root != folder:
 47                    src = os.path.join(root, file)
 48                    dst = os.path.join(folder, file)
 49                    if not os.path.exists(dst):
 50                        shutil.move(src, folder)
 51            for d in dirs:
 52                if root != folder:
 53                    shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(root, d), ignore_errors=True)
 54
 55    def _download_data(ver: int) -> None:
 56        try:
 57            import tensorflow as tf
 58            url = f"https://ndownloader.figshare.com/articles/16912366/versions/{ver}"
 59            target_file_name = "16912366.zip"
 60            tf.keras.utils.get_file(
 61                target_file_name,
 62                url,
 63                cache_subdir=DATA_PATH,
 64                extract=True,
 65            )
 66            _mv_subfolder_files(DATA_PATH, False)
 67            zip_path = os.path.join(DATA_PATH, target_file_name)
 68            if os.path.exists(zip_path):
 69                os.remove(zip_path)
 70        except Exception as err:
 71            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download ANTsPyMM reference data: {err}") from err
 72
 73    if force_download:
 74        _download_data(version)
 75
 76    files: list[str] = []
 77    if os.path.exists(DATA_PATH):
 78        for fname in os.listdir(DATA_PATH):
 79            if fname.endswith(target_extension):
 80                files.append(os.path.join(DATA_PATH, fname))
 81
 82    if len(files) == 0 and not force_download:
 83        _download_data(version)
 84        if os.path.exists(DATA_PATH):
 85            for fname in os.listdir(DATA_PATH):
 86                if fname.endswith(target_extension):
 87                    files.append(os.path.join(DATA_PATH, fname))
 88
 89    if name == "all":
 90        return files
 91
 92    if name is None:
 93        return None
 94
 95    for fname in os.listdir(DATA_PATH):
 96        p = Path(fname)
 97        stem = p.resolve().stem
 98        while "." in stem:
 99            stem = Path(stem).stem
100        if name == stem and fname.endswith(target_extension):
101            return os.path.join(DATA_PATH, fname)
102
103    return None

Get ANTsPyMM data filename.

The first time this is called, it will download data to ~/.antspymm. After, it will just read data from disk.

Arguments

name : string name of data tag to retrieve. Options: None, 'all', or specific tag stem. force_download : boolean Whether to re-download even if files exist. version : integer Version of data to download. target_extension : string Target file extension to filter by (default: '.csv').

Returns

string or list of strings or None Filepath or list of filepaths of selected data.

def apply_transforms_mixed_interpolation( fixed: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, moving: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, transformlist: list[str], interpolator: str = 'linear', imagetype: int = 0, whichtoinvert: list[bool] | None = None, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
267def apply_transforms_mixed_interpolation(
268    fixed: ants.ANTsImage,
269    moving: ants.ANTsImage,
270    transformlist: list[str],
271    interpolator: str = "linear",
272    imagetype: int = 0,
273    whichtoinvert: list[bool] | None = None,
274    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
275    **kwargs: Any,
276) -> ants.ANTsImage:
277    """Apply ANTs transforms with linear interpolation inside mask, nearest neighbor outside."""
278    if mask is None:
279        raise ValueError("A binary `mask` image must be provided.")
280
281    interp_linear = ants.apply_transforms(
282        fixed=fixed,
283        moving=moving,
284        transformlist=transformlist,
285        interpolator=interpolator,
286        imagetype=imagetype,
287        whichtoinvert=whichtoinvert,
288        **kwargs,
289    )
290    interp_nn = ants.apply_transforms(
291        fixed=fixed,
292        moving=moving,
293        transformlist=transformlist,
294        interpolator="nearestNeighbor",
295        imagetype=imagetype,
296        whichtoinvert=whichtoinvert,
297        **kwargs,
298    )
299    return (interp_linear * mask) + (interp_nn * (1.0 - mask))

Apply ANTs transforms with linear interpolation inside mask, nearest neighbor outside.

def bvec_reorientation( motion_parameters: list[typing.Any] | None, bvecs: numpy.ndarray, rebase: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> numpy.ndarray: 
254def bvec_reorientation(motion_parameters: list[Any] | None, bvecs: np.ndarray, rebase: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
255    """Reorient bvecs based on rigid/affine motion parameters."""
256    if motion_parameters is None:
257        return bvecs
258    n = len(motion_parameters)
259    if n < 1:
260        return bvecs
261    for myidx in range(n):
262        if myidx < bvecs.shape[0] and motion_parameters[myidx] != "NA":
263            temp = motion_parameters[myidx]
264            if len(temp) in [3, 4]:
265                tx1 = ants.read_transform(temp[-1])
266                p1 = ants.get_ants_transform_parameters(tx1)[0:9].reshape([3, 3])
267                tx2 = ants.read_transform(temp[1])
268                p2 = ants.get_ants_transform_parameters(tx2)[0:9].reshape([3, 3])
269                rinv = inv(p2 @ p1)
270            else:
271                tx_file = temp[1] if len(temp) == 2 else temp[0]
272                tx = ants.read_transform(tx_file)
273                p = ants.get_ants_transform_parameters(tx)[0:9].reshape([3, 3])
274                rinv = inv(p)
275            bvecs[myidx, :] = rinv @ bvecs[myidx, :]
276            if rebase is not None:
277                bvecs[myidx, :] = rebase @ bvecs[myidx, :]
278    return bvecs

Reorient bvecs based on rigid/affine motion parameters.

def concat_dewarp( refimg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, original_dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, phys_space_dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, dwp_tx: list[str], motion_parameters: list[typing.Any], motion_correct: bool = True, verbose: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
924def concat_dewarp(
925    refimg: ants.ANTsImage,
926    original_dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
927    phys_space_dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
928    dwp_tx: list[str],
929    motion_parameters: list[Any],
930    motion_correct: bool = True,
931    verbose: bool = False,
932) -> ants.ANTsImage:
933    """Apply concatenated motion correction and dewarping transforms to timeseries image."""
934    dwpimage = []
935    for myidx in range(original_dwi.shape[3]):
936        b0 = ants.slice_image(original_dwi, axis=3, idx=myidx)
937        concatx = dwp_tx.copy()
938        if motion_correct:
939            concatx = concatx + motion_parameters[myidx]
940        warpedb0 = ants.apply_transforms(refimg, b0, concatx, interpolator="nearestNeighbor")
941        dwpimage.append(warpedb0)
942    return ants.list_to_ndimage(phys_space_dwi, dwpimage)

Apply concatenated motion correction and dewarping transforms to timeseries image.

def deformation_gradient_optimized( warp_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, to_rotation: bool = False, to_inverse_rotation: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray: 
159def deformation_gradient_optimized(
160    warp_image: ants.ANTsImage,
161    to_rotation: bool = False,
162    to_inverse_rotation: bool = False,
163) -> np.ndarray:
164    """Compute the deformation gradient tensor from a displacement (warp) field image."""
165    if not ants.is_image(warp_image):
166        raise RuntimeError("ANTsImage is required")
167    dim = warp_image.dimension
168    tshp = warp_image.shape
169    tdir = warp_image.direction
170    spc = warp_image.spacing
171    warpnp = warp_image.numpy()
172    gradient_list = [np.gradient(warpnp[..., k], *spc, axis=range(dim)) for k in range(dim)]
173    dg = np.stack([np.stack(grad_k, axis=-1) for grad_k in gradient_list], axis=-1)
174    dg = (tdir @ dg).swapaxes(-1, -2)
175    dg += np.eye(dim)
176    if to_rotation or to_inverse_rotation:
177        u, _, vh = np.linalg.svd(dg)
178        z = u @ vh
179        dets = np.linalg.det(z)
180        reflection_mask = dets < 0
181        vh[reflection_mask, -1, :] *= -1
182        z[reflection_mask] = u[reflection_mask] @ vh[reflection_mask]
183        dg = z
184        if to_inverse_rotation:
185            dg = np.transpose(dg, axes=(*range(dg.ndim - 2), dg.ndim - 1, dg.ndim - 2))
186    new_shape = tshp + (dim, dim)
187    return np.reshape(dg, new_shape)

Compute the deformation gradient tensor from a displacement (warp) field image.

def dewarp_imageset( image_list: list[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage], initial_template: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, iterations: int = 2, padding: int = 0, target_idx: list[int] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
767def dewarp_imageset(
768    image_list: list[ants.ANTsImage],
769    initial_template: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
770    iterations: int = 2,
771    padding: int = 0,
772    target_idx: list[int] | None = None,
773    **kwargs: Any,
774) -> dict[str, Any]:
775    """Dewarp a set of 2D, 3D, or 4D images into an unbiased shape-space reference."""
776    if target_idx is None:
777        target_idx = [0]
778    outlist = []
779    avglist = []
780    if len(image_list[0].shape) > 3:
781        imagetype = 3
782        for k in range(len(image_list)):
783            for j in range(len(target_idx)):
784                avglist.append(ants.slice_image(image_list[k], axis=3, idx=target_idx[j]))
785    else:
786        imagetype = 0
787        avglist = list(image_list)
788
789    if padding > 0:
790        pw = [padding] * len(avglist[0].shape)
791        for k in range(len(avglist)):
792            avglist[k] = ants.pad_image(avglist[k], pad_width=pw)
793
794    if initial_template is None:
795        initial_template = avglist[0] * 0.0
796        for k in range(len(avglist)):
797            initial_template = initial_template + avglist[k] / float(len(avglist))
798
799    btp = ants.build_template(
800        initial_template=initial_template,
801        image_list=avglist,
802        gradient_step=0.5,
803        blending_weight=0.8,
804        iterations=iterations,
805        verbose=False,
806        **kwargs,
807    )
808
809    mocoplist = []
810    mocofdlist = []
811    reglist = []
812    for k in range(len(image_list)):
813        if imagetype == 3:
814            moco0 = ants.motion_correction(
815                image=image_list[k],
816                fixed=btp,
817                type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
818            )
819            mocoplist.append(moco0["motion_parameters"])
820            mocofdlist.append(moco0["FD"])
821            locavg = ants.slice_image(moco0["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=0) * 0.0
822            for j in range(len(target_idx)):
823                locavg = locavg + ants.slice_image(moco0["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=target_idx[j])
824            locavg = locavg * (1.0 / len(target_idx))
825        else:
826            locavg = image_list[k]
827            moco0 = None
828
829        reg = ants.registration(btp, locavg, **kwargs)
830        reglist.append(reg)
831
832        if imagetype == 3 and moco0 is not None:
833            myishape = image_list[k].shape
834            mytslength = myishape[-1]
835            mywarpedlist = []
836            for j in range(mytslength):
837                locimg = ants.slice_image(image_list[k], axis=3, idx=j)
838                mywarped = ants.apply_transforms(
839                    btp, locimg, reg["fwdtransforms"] + moco0["motion_parameters"][j], imagetype=0
840                )
841                mywarpedlist.append(mywarped)
842            mywarped_img = ants.list_to_ndimage(image_list[k], mywarpedlist)
843        else:
844            mywarped_img = ants.apply_transforms(btp, image_list[k], reg["fwdtransforms"], imagetype=imagetype)
845        outlist.append(mywarped_img)
846
847    return {
848        "dewarpedmean": btp,
849        "dewarped": outlist,
850        "deformable_registrations": reglist,
851        "FD": mocofdlist,
852        "motionparameters": mocoplist,
853    }

Dewarp a set of 2D, 3D, or 4D images into an unbiased shape-space reference.

def distortion_correct_bvecs( bvecs: numpy.ndarray, def_grad: numpy.ndarray, a_img: numpy.ndarray, a_ref: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray: 
143def distortion_correct_bvecs(
144    bvecs: np.ndarray,
145    def_grad: np.ndarray,
146    a_img: np.ndarray,
147    a_ref: np.ndarray,
148) -> np.ndarray:
149    """Vectorized computation of voxel-wise distortion corrected b-vectors."""
150    a = a_ref.T @ a_img
151    r_voxel = np.einsum("ij,xyzjk->xyzik", a, def_grad)
152    r_voxel_reshaped = r_voxel.reshape(-1, 3, 3)
153    rotated = np.einsum("vij,nj->vni", r_voxel_reshaped, bvecs)
154    norms = np.linalg.norm(rotated, axis=2, keepdims=True)
155    rotated /= np.clip(norms, 1e-8, None)
156    return rotated.reshape(def_grad.shape[:3] + (bvecs.shape[0], 3))

Vectorized computation of voxel-wise distortion corrected b-vectors.

def dti_reg( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, avg_b0: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, avg_dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bvals: Any = None, bvecs: Any = None, b0_idx: list[int] | None = None, type_of_transform: str = 'antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]', total_sigma: float = 3.0, fdOffset: float = 2.0, mask_csf: bool = False, brain_mask_eroded: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, output_directory: str | None = None, verbose: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
281def dti_reg(
282    image: ants.ANTsImage,
283    avg_b0: ants.ANTsImage,
284    avg_dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
285    bvals: Any = None,
286    bvecs: Any = None,
287    b0_idx: list[int] | None = None,
288    type_of_transform: str = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
289    total_sigma: float = 3.0,
290    fdOffset: float = 2.0,
291    mask_csf: bool = False,
292    brain_mask_eroded: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
293    output_directory: str | None = None,
294    verbose: bool = False,
295    **kwargs: Any,
296) -> dict[str, Any]:
297    """Correct DWI time-series data for motion with optional deformation."""
298    idim = image.dimension
299    ishape = image.shape
300    n_time_points = ishape[idim - 1]
301    fd = np.zeros(n_time_points)
302
303    if bvals is not None and bvecs is not None:
304        if isinstance(bvecs, str):
305            bvals, bvecs = read_bvals_bvecs(bvals, bvecs)
306        else:
307            bvals = bvals.copy()
308            bvecs = bvecs.copy()
309
310    if type_of_transform is None:
311        return {
312            "motion_corrected": image,
313            "motion_parameters": None,
314            "FD": fd,
315            "bvals": bvals,
316            "bvecs": bvecs,
317        }
318
319    remove_it = False
320    if output_directory is None:
321        remove_it = True
322        output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
323    output_directory_w = os.path.join(output_directory, "dti_reg")
324    os.makedirs(output_directory_w, exist_ok=True)
325    ofn_g = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix="global_deformation", dir=output_directory_w).name
326    ofn_l = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix="local_deformation", dir=output_directory_w).name
327
328    if b0_idx is None:
329        b0_idx = segment_timeseries_by_bvalue(bvals)["lowbvals"]
330
331    ab0, adw = get_average_dwi_b0(image)
332    mask = ants.threshold_image(ants.iMath(adw, "Normalize"), 0.1, 1.0)
333    if brain_mask_eroded is None:
334        brain_mask_eroded = mask * 0 + 1
335
336    motion_parameters: list[Any] = []
337    motion_corrected: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
338    center_of_mass = mask.get_center_of_mass()
339    npts = pow(2, idim - 1)
340    myrad = np.ones(idim - 1, dtype=int).tolist()
341    mask1vals = np.zeros(int(mask.sum()))
342    mask1vals[round(len(mask1vals) / 2)] = 1
343    mask1 = ants.make_image(mask, mask1vals)
344    myoffsets = ants.get_neighborhood_in_mask(mask1, mask1, radius=myrad, spatial_info=True)["offsets"]
345    mycols = list("xyz" if idim - 1 == 3 else "xy")
346    useinds: list[int] = []
347    for k in range(myoffsets.shape[0]):
348        if abs(myoffsets[k, :]).sum() == (idim - 2):
349            useinds.append(k)
350        myoffsets[k, :] = myoffsets[k, :] * fdOffset / 2.0 + center_of_mass
351    fdpts = pd.DataFrame(data=myoffsets[useinds, :], columns=mycols)
352
353    initrig = ants.registration(avg_b0, ab0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=ofn_g)
354    deftx = ants.registration(
355        avg_dwi,
356        adw,
357        "SyNOnly",
358        syn_metric="CC",
359        syn_sampling=2,
360        reg_iterations=[50, 50, 20],
361        multivariate_extras=[["CC", avg_b0, ab0, 1, 2]],
362        initial_transform=initrig["fwdtransforms"][0],
363        outprefix=ofn_g,
364    )["fwdtransforms"]
365
366    counter = round(n_time_points / 10) + 1
367    for k in range(n_time_points):
368        if verbose and (k % counter == 0 or k == n_time_points - 1):
369            print(f"{round(k / n_time_points * 100)}%.", end="", flush=True)
370        fixed = ants.image_clone(ab0 if k in b0_idx else adw)
371        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
372        temp = ants.iMath(temp, "Normalize")
373        txprefix = f"{ofn_l}{str(k).zfill(4)}rig_"
374        txprefix2 = f"{ofn_l}{str(k % 2).zfill(4)}def_"
375
376        if temp.numpy().var() > 0:
377            myrig = ants.registration(fixed, temp, type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=txprefix, **kwargs)
378            if type_of_transform == "SyN":
379                myreg = ants.registration(
380                    fixed, temp, type_of_transform="SyNOnly", total_sigma=total_sigma,
381                    grad_step=0.1, initial_transform=myrig["fwdtransforms"][0], outprefix=txprefix2, **kwargs
382                )
383            else:
384                myreg = myrig
385            fdpts_tx = ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, myrig["fwdtransforms"])
386            fdpts_prev = (
387                ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, motion_parameters[k - 1])
388                if k > 0 and motion_parameters[k - 1] != "NA"
389                else fdpts_tx
390            )
391            fd[k] = (fdpts_prev - fdpts_tx).abs().mean().sum()
392            motion_parameters.append(myreg["fwdtransforms"])
393        else:
394            motion_parameters.append("NA")
395
396        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
397        if temp.numpy().var() > 0:
398            motion_parameters[k] = deftx + motion_parameters[k]
399            img1w = apply_transforms_mixed_interpolation(
400                avg_dwi, ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k), motion_parameters[k], mask=brain_mask_eroded
401            )
402            motion_corrected.append(img1w)
403        else:
404            motion_corrected.append(fixed)
405
406    if bvecs is not None:
407        rebase = np.transpose(avg_b0.direction) @ ab0.direction
408        bvecs = bvec_reorientation(motion_parameters, bvecs, rebase)
409
410    if remove_it:
411        shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
412
413    d4siz = list(avg_b0.shape) + [2]
414    spc = list(ants.get_spacing(avg_b0)) + [1.0]
415    mydir4d = ants.get_direction(image)
416    mydir4d[0:3, 0:3] = ants.get_direction(avg_b0)
417    myorg = list(ants.get_origin(avg_b0)) + [0.0]
418    avg_b0_4d = ants.make_image(d4siz, 0, spacing=spc, origin=myorg, direction=mydir4d)
419
420    return {
421        "motion_corrected": ants.list_to_ndimage(avg_b0_4d, motion_corrected),
422        "motion_parameters": motion_parameters,
423        "FD": fd,
424        "bvals": bvals,
425        "bvecs": bvecs,
426    }

Correct DWI time-series data for motion with optional deformation.

def dti_template( b_image_list: list[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage] | None = None, w_image_list: list[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage] | None = None, iterations: int = 5, gradient_step: float = 0.5, mask_csf: bool = False, average_both: bool = True, verbose: bool = False) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
478def dti_template(
479    b_image_list: list[ants.ANTsImage] | None = None,
480    w_image_list: list[ants.ANTsImage] | None = None,
481    iterations: int = 5,
482    gradient_step: float = 0.5,
483    mask_csf: bool = False,
484    average_both: bool = True,
485    verbose: bool = False,
486) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage]:
487    """Two-channel version of build_template returning (avg_b0, avg_dwi)."""
488    if b_image_list is None or w_image_list is None:
489        raise ValueError("Both b_image_list and w_image_list must be provided.")
490
491    output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
492    mydeftx = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=output_directory).name
493    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=output_directory, suffix=".nii.gz")
494    wavgfn = tmp.name
495    tmp2 = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=output_directory)
496    comptx = tmp2.name
497    weights = [1.0 / len(b_image_list)] * len(b_image_list)
498
499    b_initial_template = ants.iMath(b_image_list[0], "Normalize")
500    w_initial_template = ants.iMath(w_image_list[0], "Normalize")
501
502    if mask_csf:
503        bcsf0 = ants.threshold_image(b_image_list[0], "Otsu", 2).threshold_image(1, 1).morphology("open", 1).iMath("GetLargestComponent")
504        bcsf1 = ants.threshold_image(b_image_list[1], "Otsu", 2).threshold_image(1, 1).morphology("open", 1).iMath("GetLargestComponent")
505    else:
506        bcsf0 = b_image_list[0] * 0 + 1
507        bcsf1 = b_image_list[1] * 0 + 1
508    bavg = b_initial_template.clone() * bcsf0
509    wavg = w_initial_template.clone() * bcsf0
510    bcsf = [bcsf0, bcsf1]
511
512    for i in range(iterations):
513        for k in range(len(w_image_list)):
514            fimg, mimg = wavg, w_image_list[k] * bcsf[k]
515            fimg2, mimg2 = bavg, b_image_list[k] * bcsf[k]
516            w1 = ants.registration(
517                fimg, mimg, type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNQuickRepro[s]",
518                multivariate_extras=[["CC", fimg2, mimg2, 1, 2]], outprefix=mydeftx, verbose=0
519            )
520            txname = ants.apply_transforms(wavg, wavg, w1["fwdtransforms"], compose=comptx)
521            if k == 0:
522                txavg = ants.image_read(txname) * weights[k]
523                wavgnew = ants.apply_transforms(wavg, w_image_list[k] * bcsf[k], txname).iMath("Normalize")
524                bavgnew = ants.apply_transforms(wavg, b_image_list[k] * bcsf[k], txname).iMath("Normalize")
525            else:
526                txavg = txavg + ants.image_read(txname) * weights[k]
527                if i >= (iterations - 2) and average_both:
528                    wavgnew = wavgnew + ants.apply_transforms(wavg, w_image_list[k] * bcsf[k], txname).iMath("Normalize")
529                    bavgnew = bavgnew + ants.apply_transforms(wavg, b_image_list[k] * bcsf[k], txname).iMath("Normalize")
530        if verbose:
531            print(f"iteration: {i} {float(txavg.abs().mean())}")
532        txavg = txavg * (-1.0 * gradient_step)
533        ants.image_write(txavg, wavgfn)
534        wavg = ants.apply_transforms(wavg, wavgnew, wavgfn).iMath("Normalize")
535        bavg = ants.apply_transforms(bavg, bavgnew, wavgfn).iMath("Normalize")
536
537    shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
538    return bavg, wavg

Two-channel version of build_template returning (avg_b0, avg_dwi).

def generate_voxelwise_bvecs( global_bvecs: numpy.ndarray, voxel_rotations: numpy.ndarray, transpose: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray: 
237def generate_voxelwise_bvecs(global_bvecs: np.ndarray, voxel_rotations: np.ndarray, transpose: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
238    """Generate voxel-wise b-vectors from global bvec and voxel-wise rotation field."""
239    x, y, z, _, _ = voxel_rotations.shape
240    n = global_bvecs.shape[0]
241    bvecs_5d = np.zeros((x, y, z, n, 3), dtype=np.float32)
242    for n_idx in range(n):
243        bvec = global_bvecs[n_idx]
244        for i in range(x):
245            for j in range(y):
246                for k in range(z):
247                    r = voxel_rotations[i, j, k]
248                    if transpose:
249                        r = r.T
250                    bvecs_5d[i, j, k, n_idx, :] = r @ bvec
251    return bvecs_5d

Generate voxel-wise b-vectors from global bvec and voxel-wise rotation field.

def get_average_dwi_b0( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fixed_b0: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, fixed_dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, fast: bool = False) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
429def get_average_dwi_b0(
430    x: ants.ANTsImage,
431    fixed_b0: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
432    fixed_dwi: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
433    fast: bool = False,
434) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage]:
435    """Automatically generates average b0 and dwi; maps dwi to b0 space."""
436    output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
437    ofn = os.path.join(output_directory, "w")
438    temp = segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(x)
439    b0_idx = temp["highermeans"]
440    non_b0_idx = temp["lowermeans"]
441
442    if (fixed_b0 is None and fixed_dwi is None) or fast:
443        xavg = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=0) * 0.0
444        bavg = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=0) * 0.0
445        fixed_b0_use = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=b0_idx[0])
446        fixed_dwi_use = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=non_b0_idx[0])
447    else:
448        temp_b0 = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=b0_idx[0])
449        temp_dwi = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=non_b0_idx[0])
450        xavg = fixed_b0 * 0.0
451        bavg = fixed_b0 * 0.0
452        tempreg = ants.registration(fixed_b0, temp_b0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")
453        fixed_b0_use = tempreg["warpedmovout"]
454        fixed_dwi_use = ants.apply_transforms(fixed_b0, temp_dwi, tempreg["fwdtransforms"])
455
456    for myidx in range(x.shape[3]):
457        b0 = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=myidx)
458        if not fast:
459            if myidx not in b0_idx:
460                xavg = xavg + ants.registration(fixed_dwi_use, b0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=ofn)["warpedmovout"]
461            else:
462                bavg = bavg + ants.registration(fixed_b0_use, b0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=ofn)["warpedmovout"]
463        else:
464            if myidx not in b0_idx:
465                xavg = xavg + b0
466            else:
467                bavg = bavg + b0
468
469    bavg = ants.iMath(bavg, "Normalize")
470    xavg = ants.iMath(xavg, "Normalize")
471    shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
472    avgb0 = ants.n4_bias_field_correction(bavg)
473    avgdwi = ants.n4_bias_field_correction(xavg)
474    avgdwi = ants.registration(avgb0, avgdwi, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")["warpedmovout"]
475    return avgb0, avgdwi

Automatically generates average b0 and dwi; maps dwi to b0 space.

def get_average_rsf( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, min_t: int = 10, max_t: int = 35) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
439def get_average_rsf(x: ants.ANTsImage, min_t: int = 10, max_t: int = 35) -> ants.ANTsImage:
440    """Automatically generates average bold image with registration."""
441    output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
442    ofn = os.path.join(output_directory, "w")
443    bavg = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=0) * 0.0
444    oavg = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=0)
445    if x.shape[3] <= min_t:
446        min_t = 0
447    if x.shape[3] <= max_t:
448        max_t = x.shape[3]
449    for myidx in range(min_t, max_t):
450        b0 = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=myidx)
451        bavg = bavg + ants.registration(oavg, b0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=ofn)["warpedmovout"]
452    bavg = ants.iMath(bavg, "Normalize")
453    oavg = ants.image_clone(bavg)
454    bavg = oavg * 0.0
455    for myidx in range(min_t, max_t):
456        b0 = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=myidx)
457        bavg = bavg + ants.registration(oavg, b0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=ofn)["warpedmovout"]
458    shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
459    return ants.iMath(bavg, "Normalize")

Automatically generates average bold image with registration.

def mc_reg( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fixed: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, type_of_transform: str = 'antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]', mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, total_sigma: float = 3.0, fdOffset: float = 2.0, output_directory: str | None = None, verbose: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
477def mc_reg(
478    image: ants.ANTsImage,
479    fixed: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
480    type_of_transform: str = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
481    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
482    total_sigma: float = 3.0,
483    fdOffset: float = 2.0,
484    output_directory: str | None = None,
485    verbose: bool = False,
486    **kwargs: Any,
487) -> dict[str, Any]:
488    """Correct time-series data for motion with optional deformation."""
489    remove_it = False
490    if output_directory is None:
491        remove_it = True
492        output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
493    output_directory_w = os.path.join(output_directory, "mc_reg")
494    os.makedirs(output_directory_w, exist_ok=True)
495    ofn_l = os.path.join(output_directory_w, "local_def_")
496
497    idim = image.dimension
498    ishape = image.shape
499    n_time_points = ishape[idim - 1]
500    if fixed is None:
501        fixed = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(image)
502    if mask is None:
503        mask = ants.get_mask(fixed)
504
505    fd = np.zeros(n_time_points)
506    motion_parameters: list[Any] = []
507    motion_corrected: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
508    center_of_mass = mask.get_center_of_mass()
509    myrad = np.ones(idim - 1, dtype=int).tolist()
510    mask1vals = np.zeros(int(mask.sum()))
511    mask1vals[round(len(mask1vals) / 2)] = 1
512    mask1 = ants.make_image(mask, mask1vals)
513    myoffsets = ants.get_neighborhood_in_mask(mask1, mask1, radius=myrad, spatial_info=True)["offsets"]
514    mycols = list("xy") if idim - 1 == 2 else list("xyz")
515
516    useinds = [k for k in range(myoffsets.shape[0]) if abs(myoffsets[k, :]).sum() == (idim - 2)]
517    myoffsets = myoffsets * fdOffset / 2.0 + center_of_mass
518    fdpts = pd.DataFrame(data=myoffsets[useinds, :], columns=mycols)
519
520    for k in range(n_time_points):
521        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
522        temp = ants.iMath(temp, "Normalize")
523        if temp.numpy().var() > 0:
524            tx_prefix_k = f"{ofn_l}{str(k).zfill(4)}_"
525            myrig = ants.registration(
526                fixed,
527                temp,
528                type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
529                outprefix=tx_prefix_k,
530                **kwargs,
531            )
532            if type_of_transform == "SyN":
533                myreg = ants.registration(
534                    fixed,
535                    temp,
536                    type_of_transform="SyNOnly",
537                    total_sigma=total_sigma,
538                    initial_transform=myrig["fwdtransforms"][0],
539                    outprefix=tx_prefix_k,
540                    **kwargs,
541                )
542            else:
543                myreg = myrig
544            fdpts_tx = ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, myreg["fwdtransforms"])
545            fdpts_prev = (
546                ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, motion_parameters[k - 1])
547                if k > 0 and motion_parameters[k - 1] != "NA"
548                else fdpts_tx
549            )
550            fd[k] = (fdpts_prev - fdpts_tx).abs().mean().sum()
551            motion_parameters.append(myreg["fwdtransforms"])
552            img_warped = ants.apply_transforms(
553                fixed,
554                ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k),
555                myreg["fwdtransforms"],
556            )
557            motion_corrected.append(img_warped)
558        else:
559            motion_parameters.append("NA")
560            motion_corrected.append(temp)
561
562    if remove_it:
563        shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
564
565    return {
566        "motion_corrected": ants.list_to_ndimage(image, motion_corrected),
567        "motion_parameters": motion_parameters,
568        "FD": fd,
569    }

def read_ants_transforms_to_numpy(transform_files: list[list[str]]) -> numpy.ndarray: 
541def read_ants_transforms_to_numpy(transform_files: list[list[str]]) -> np.ndarray:
542    """Read a list of ANTs transform files and convert them to a NumPy array."""
543    filtered_lists = [[s for s in sublist if s.endswith(".mat")] for sublist in transform_files]
544    transforms = []
545    for f in filtered_lists:
546        tx = ants.read_transform(f[0])
547        transforms.append(np.array(ants.get_ants_transform_parameters(tx)[0:9]))
548    return np.array(transforms)

Read a list of ANTs transform files and convert them to a NumPy array.

def timeseries_reg( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, avg_b0: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, type_of_transform: str = 'antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]', total_sigma: float = 1.0, fdOffset: float = 2.0, trim: int = 0, output_directory: str | None = None, return_numpy_motion_parameters: bool = False, verbose: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
332def timeseries_reg(
333    image: ants.ANTsImage,
334    avg_b0: ants.ANTsImage,
335    type_of_transform: str = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
336    total_sigma: float = 1.0,
337    fdOffset: float = 2.0,
338    trim: int = 0,
339    output_directory: str | None = None,
340    return_numpy_motion_parameters: bool = False,
341    verbose: bool = False,
342    **kwargs: Any,
343) -> dict[str, Any]:
344    """Correct BOLD time-series data for motion."""
345    idim = image.dimension
346    ishape = image.shape
347    n_time_points = ishape[idim - 1]
348    fd = np.zeros(n_time_points)
349
350    if type_of_transform is None:
351        return {"motion_corrected": image, "motion_parameters": None, "FD": fd}
352
353    remove_it = False
354    if output_directory is None:
355        remove_it = True
356        output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
357    output_directory_w = os.path.join(output_directory, "ts_reg")
358    os.makedirs(output_directory_w, exist_ok=True)
359    ofn_l = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix="local_deformation", dir=output_directory_w).name
360
361    motion_parameters: list[Any] = []
362    motion_corrected: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
363    mask = ants.get_mask(avg_b0)
364    center_of_mass = mask.get_center_of_mass()
365    npts = pow(2, idim - 1)
366    myrad = np.ones(idim - 1, dtype=int).tolist()
367    mask1vals = np.zeros(int(mask.sum()))
368    mask1vals[round(len(mask1vals) / 2)] = 1
369    mask1 = ants.make_image(mask, mask1vals)
370    myoffsets = ants.get_neighborhood_in_mask(mask1, mask1, radius=myrad, spatial_info=True)["offsets"]
371    mycols = list("xyz" if idim - 1 == 3 else "xy")
372    useinds: list[int] = []
373    for k in range(myoffsets.shape[0]):
374        if abs(myoffsets[k, :]).sum() == (idim - 2):
375            useinds.append(k)
376        myoffsets[k, :] = myoffsets[k, :] * fdOffset / 2.0 + center_of_mass
377    fdpts = pd.DataFrame(data=myoffsets[useinds, :], columns=mycols)
378
379    counter = round(n_time_points / 10) + 1
380    for k in range(n_time_points):
381        if verbose and (k % counter == 0 or k == n_time_points - 1):
382            print(f"{round(k / n_time_points * 100)}%.", end="", flush=True)
383        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
384        temp = ants.iMath(temp, "Normalize")
385        txprefix = f"{ofn_l}{str(k % 2).zfill(4)}_"
386        if temp.numpy().var() > 0:
387            myrig = ants.registration(avg_b0, temp, type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", outprefix=txprefix)
388            if type_of_transform == "SyN":
389                myreg = ants.registration(
390                    avg_b0, temp, type_of_transform="SyNOnly", total_sigma=total_sigma,
391                    initial_transform=myrig["fwdtransforms"][0], outprefix=txprefix, **kwargs
392                )
393            else:
394                myreg = myrig
395            fdpts_tx = ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, myrig["fwdtransforms"])
396            fdpts_prev = (
397                ants.apply_transforms_to_points(idim - 1, fdpts, motion_parameters[k - 1])
398                if k > 0 and motion_parameters[k - 1] != "NA"
399                else fdpts_tx
400            )
401            fd[k] = (fdpts_prev - fdpts_tx).abs().mean().sum()
402            motion_parameters.append(myreg["fwdtransforms"])
403        else:
404            motion_parameters.append("NA")
405
406        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
407        if temp.numpy().var() > 0:
408            img1w = ants.apply_transforms(avg_b0, temp, motion_parameters[k])
409            motion_corrected.append(img1w)
410        else:
411            motion_corrected.append(avg_b0)
412
413    motion_parameters = motion_parameters[trim:]
414    if return_numpy_motion_parameters:
415        filtered = [[s for s in sublist if s.endswith(".mat")] for sublist in motion_parameters if sublist != "NA"]
416        np_params = []
417        for fl in filtered:
418            tx = ants.read_transform(fl[0])
419            np_params.append(np.array(ants.get_ants_transform_parameters(tx)[0:9]))
420        motion_parameters = np.array(np_params)
421
422    if remove_it:
423        shutil.rmtree(output_directory, ignore_errors=True)
424
425    d4siz = list(avg_b0.shape) + [2]
426    spc = list(ants.get_spacing(avg_b0)) + [float(ants.get_spacing(image)[3])]
427    mydir4d = ants.get_direction(image)
428    mydir4d[0:3, 0:3] = ants.get_direction(avg_b0)
429    myorg = list(ants.get_origin(avg_b0)) + [0.0]
430    avg_b0_4d = ants.make_image(d4siz, 0, spacing=spc, origin=myorg, direction=mydir4d)
431
432    return {
433        "motion_corrected": ants.list_to_ndimage(avg_b0_4d, motion_corrected[trim:]),
434        "motion_parameters": motion_parameters,
435        "FD": fd[trim:],
436    }

Correct BOLD time-series data for motion.

def timeseries_transform( transform: Any, image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, reference: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, interpolation: str = 'linear') -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
315def timeseries_transform(transform: Any, image: ants.ANTsImage, reference: ants.ANTsImage, interpolation: str = "linear") -> ants.ANTsImage:
316    """Apply spatial transform to each volume in 4D timeseries."""
317    if image.dimension != 4:
318        raise ValueError("Input image must be 4D (X, Y, Z, T).")
319    transformed_volumes = []
320    for t in range(image.shape[3]):
321        vol = ants.slice_image(image, 3, t)
322        transformed = ants.apply_ants_transform_to_image(
323            transform=transform, image=vol, reference=reference, interpolation=interpolation
324        )
325        transformed_volumes.append(transformed.numpy())
326    transformed_array = np.stack(transformed_volumes, axis=-1)
327    out_image = ants.from_numpy(transformed_array)
328    out_image = ants.copy_image_info(image, out_image)
329    return copy_spatial_metadata_from_3d_to_4d(reference, out_image)

Apply spatial transform to each volume in 4D timeseries.

def tra_initializer( fixed: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, moving: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, n_simulations: int = 32, max_rotation: float = 30.0, transform: list[str] | None = None, compreg: Any = None, random_seed: int | None = 42, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
16def tra_initializer(
17    fixed: ants.ANTsImage,
18    moving: ants.ANTsImage,
19    n_simulations: int = 32,
20    max_rotation: float = 30.0,
21    transform: list[str] | None = None,
22    compreg: Any = None,
23    random_seed: int | None = 42,
24    verbose: bool = False,
25) -> dict[str, Any]:
26    """Multi-start multi-transform registration initialization based on ants.registration."""
27    if transform is None:
28        transform = ["rigid"]
29    if random_seed is not None:
30        random.seed(random_seed)
31
32    output_directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
33    output_directory_w = os.path.join(output_directory, "tra_reg")
34    os.makedirs(output_directory_w, exist_ok=True)
35    bestmi = math.inf
36    bestvar = 0.0
37    myorig = list(ants.get_origin(fixed))
38    mymax = max(abs(x) for x in myorig) if myorig else 1.0
39    maxtrans = mymax * 0.05
40
41    if compreg is None:
42        bestreg = ants.registration(fixed, moving, "Translation", outprefix=os.path.join(output_directory_w, "trans"))
43        initx = ants.read_transform(bestreg["fwdtransforms"][0])
44    else:
45        bestreg = compreg
46        initx = ants.read_transform(bestreg["fwdtransforms"][0])
47
48    for mytx in transform:
49        regtx = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]"
50        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".h5") as tp:
51            if mytx == "translation":
52                regtx = "Translation"
53                r_rot = ants.contrib.RandomTranslate3D((maxtrans * -1.0, maxtrans), reference=fixed)
54            elif mytx == "affine":
55                regtx = "Affine"
56                r_rot = ants.contrib.RandomRotate3D((maxtrans * -1.0, maxtrans), reference=fixed)
57            else:
58                r_rot = ants.contrib.RandomRotate3D((max_rotation * -1.0, max_rotation), reference=fixed)
59
60            for k in range(n_simulations):
61                simtx = ants.compose_ants_transforms([r_rot.transform(), initx])
62                ants.write_transform(simtx, tp.name)
63                init_tf = tp.name if k > 0 else None
64                reg = ants.registration(
65                    fixed,
66                    moving,
67                    regtx,
68                    initial_transform=init_tf,
69                    outprefix=os.path.join(output_directory_w, f"reg{k}"),
70                    verbose=False,
71                )
72                temp = reg["warpedmovout"]
73                myvar = float(temp.numpy().var())
74                if myvar > 0:
75                    mymi = float(ants.image_mutual_information(fixed, temp))
76                    if mymi < bestmi:
77                        bestmi = mymi
78                        bestreg = reg
79                        bestvar = myvar
80
81    if bestvar == 0.0 and compreg is not None:
82        return compreg
83    return bestreg

Multi-start multi-transform registration initialization based on ants.registration.

def transform_and_reorient_dti( fixed: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, moving_dti: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, composite_transform: str, verbose: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
190def transform_and_reorient_dti(
191    fixed: ants.ANTsImage,
192    moving_dti: ants.ANTsImage,
193    composite_transform: str,
194    verbose: bool = False,
195    **kwargs: Any,
196) -> ants.ANTsImage:
197    """Applies transformation to DTI image using ANTs composite transform and Finite Strain reorientation."""
198    if moving_dti.dimension != 3:
199        raise ValueError("moving_dti must be 3-dimensional.")
200    if moving_dti.components != 6:
201        raise ValueError("moving_dti must have 6 components (upper triangular format).")
202
203    dtsplit = moving_dti.split_channels()
204    dtiw_channels = [
205        ants.apply_transforms(fixed, dtsplit[k], composite_transform, **kwargs)
206        for k in range(len(dtsplit))
207    ]
208    dtiw = ants.merge_channels(dtiw_channels)
209
210    wtx = ants.image_read(composite_transform)
211    r_moving_to_fixed_forward = deformation_gradient_optimized(
212        wtx, to_rotation=False, to_inverse_rotation=True
213    )
214    dtiw2tensor_np = triangular_to_tensor(dtiw)
215
216    d_world_moving_orient = np.einsum(
217        "ab, ...bc, cd -> ...ad",
218        moving_dti.direction,
219        dtiw2tensor_np,
220        moving_dti.direction.T,
221    )
222    d_world_fixed_orient = np.einsum(
223        "...ab, ...bc, ...cd -> ...ad",
224        r_moving_to_fixed_forward,
225        d_world_moving_orient,
226        np.swapaxes(r_moving_to_fixed_forward, -1, -2),
227    )
228    final_dti_tensors_numpy = np.einsum(
229        "ba, ...bc, cd -> ...ad",
230        fixed.direction,
231        d_world_fixed_orient,
232        fixed.direction,
233    )
234    return dti_numpy_to_image(fixed, final_dti_tensors_numpy)

Applies transformation to DTI image using ANTs composite transform and Finite Strain reorientation.

def augment_image( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, max_rot: float = 10.0, nzsd: float = 1.0) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, typing.Any, typing.Any]: 
13def augment_image(
14    x: ants.ANTsImage,
15    max_rot: float = 10.0,
16    nzsd: float = 1.0,
17) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, Any, Any]:
18    """Randomly rotate and add noise to an image."""
19    r_rot = ants.contrib.RandomRotate3D((max_rot * -1.0, max_rot), reference=x)
20    tx = r_rot.transform()
21    itx = ants.invert_ants_transform(tx)
22    y = ants.apply_ants_transform_to_image(tx, x, x, interpolation="linear")
23    y = ants.add_noise_to_image(y, "additivegaussian", [0, nzsd])
24    return y, tx, itx

Randomly rotate and add noise to an image.

def boot_wmh( flair: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1seg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mmfromconvexhull: float = 0.0, strict: bool = True, probability_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, prior_probability: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, n_simulations: int = 8, random_seed: int = 42, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
114def boot_wmh(
115    flair: ants.ANTsImage,
116    t1: ants.ANTsImage,
117    t1seg: ants.ANTsImage,
118    mmfromconvexhull: float = 0.0,
119    strict: bool = True,
120    probability_mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
121    prior_probability: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
122    n_simulations: int = 8,
123    random_seed: int = 42,
124    verbose: bool = False,
125) -> dict[str, Any]:
126    """Bootstrap WMH segmentation with image augmentation."""
127    random.seed(random_seed)
128    wmh_sum_aug = 0.0
129    wmh_sum_prior_aug = 0.0
130    augprob = flair * 0.0
131    augprob_prior = flair * 0.0 if prior_probability is not None else None
132    locwmh: dict[str, Any] = {}
133
134    for n in range(n_simulations):
135        augflair, _, itx = augment_image(ants.iMath(flair, "Normalize"), 5, 0.01)
136        locwmh = wmh(
137            augflair,
138            t1,
139            t1seg,
140            mmfromconvexhull=mmfromconvexhull,
141            strict=strict,
142            probability_mask=None,
143            prior_probability=prior_probability,
144        )
145        wmh_sum_aug += locwmh["wmh_mass"]
146        wmh_sum_prior_aug += locwmh["wmh_mass_prior"]
147        augprob = augprob + ants.apply_ants_transform_to_image(itx, locwmh["WMH_probability_map"], flair, interpolation="linear")
148        if prior_probability is not None and augprob_prior is not None:
149            augprob_prior = augprob_prior + ants.apply_ants_transform_to_image(
150                itx, locwmh["WMH_posterior_probability_map"], flair, interpolation="linear"
151            )
152
153    augprob = augprob * (1.0 / float(n_simulations))
154    if augprob_prior is not None:
155        augprob_prior = augprob_prior * (1.0 / float(n_simulations))
156    wmh_sum_aug = wmh_sum_aug / float(n_simulations)
157    wmh_sum_prior_aug = wmh_sum_prior_aug / float(n_simulations)
158
159    return {
160        "flair": ants.iMath(flair, "Normalize"),
161        "WMH_probability_map": augprob,
162        "WMH_posterior_probability_map": augprob_prior,
163        "wmh_mass": wmh_sum_aug,
164        "wmh_mass_prior": wmh_sum_prior_aug,
165        "wmh_evr": locwmh.get("wmh_evr", 0.0),
166        "wmh_SNR": locwmh.get("wmh_SNR", 0.0),
167    }

Bootstrap WMH segmentation with image augmentation.

def crop_mcimage( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, padder: int | None = None) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
469def crop_mcimage(x: ants.ANTsImage, mask: ants.ANTsImage, padder: int | None = None) -> ants.ANTsImage:
470    """Crop a time series (4D) image by a 3D mask."""
471    cropmask = ants.crop_image(mask, mask)
472    myorig = list(ants.get_origin(cropmask))
473    if len(x.shape) > 3:
474        myorig.append(ants.get_origin(x)[3])
475        croplist: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
476        for k in range(x.shape[3]):
477            temp = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=k)
478            temp = ants.crop_image(temp, mask)
479            if padder is not None:
480                temp = ants.pad_image(temp, pad_width=padder)
481            croplist.append(temp)
482        temp_img = ants.list_to_ndimage(x, croplist)
483        temp_img.set_origin(myorig)
484        return temp_img
485    return ants.crop_image(x, mask)

Crop a time series (4D) image by a 3D mask.

def enantiomorphic_filling_without_mask( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, axis: int = 0, intensity: str = 'low') -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
182def enantiomorphic_filling_without_mask(
183    image: ants.ANTsImage,
184    axis: int = 0,
185    intensity: str = "low",
186) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage]:
187    """Perform enantiomorphic lesion filling on an image without a prior lesion mask."""
188    imagen = ants.iMath(image, "Normalize")
189    imagen = ants.iMath(imagen, "TruncateIntensity", 1e-6, 0.98)
190    imagen = ants.iMath(imagen, "Normalize")
191
192    mirror_image = ants.reflect_image(imagen, axis=axis, tx="antsRegistrationSyNQuickRepro[s]")["warpedmovout"]
193    symmetric_image = imagen * 0.5 + mirror_image * 0.5
194    difference_image = image - symmetric_image
195    diffseg = ants.threshold_image(difference_image, "Otsu", 3)
196
197    if intensity == "low":
198        likely_lesion = ants.threshold_image(diffseg, 1, 1)
199    else:
200        likely_lesion = ants.threshold_image(diffseg, 3, 3)
201
202    likely_lesion = ants.smooth_image(likely_lesion, 3.0).iMath("Normalize")
203    lesionneg = (imagen * 0.0 + 1.0) - likely_lesion
204    filled_image = imagen * lesionneg + mirror_image * likely_lesion
205    return filled_image, diffseg

Perform enantiomorphic lesion filling on an image without a prior lesion mask.

def map_scalar_to_labels( dataframe: pandas.DataFrame, label_image_template: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
302def map_scalar_to_labels(dataframe: pd.DataFrame, label_image_template: ants.ANTsImage) -> ants.ANTsImage:
303    """Map scalar values from a DataFrame to associated integer image labels."""
304    mapped_label_image = label_image_template.clone() * 0.0
305    for _, row in dataframe.iterrows():
306        label = int(row["label"])
307        scalar_value = float(row["scalar_value"])
308        mapped_label_image[label_image_template == label] = scalar_value
309    return mapped_label_image

Map scalar values from a DataFrame to associated integer image labels.

def segment_timeseries_by_bvalue(bvals: numpy.ndarray | list[float]) -> dict[str, list[int]]: 
334def segment_timeseries_by_bvalue(bvals: np.ndarray | list[float]) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
335    """Categorize b-values into non-zero and b0 indices."""
336    threshold = 1e-12
337    bvals_arr = np.asarray(bvals)
338    lowermeans = list(np.where(bvals_arr > threshold)[0])
339    highermeans = list(np.where(bvals_arr <= threshold)[0])
340    if len(highermeans) == 0:
341        minval = float(np.min(bvals_arr))
342        lowermeans = list(np.where(bvals_arr > minval)[0])
343        highermeans = list(np.where(bvals_arr <= minval)[0])
344    return {"largerbvals": lowermeans, "lowbvals": highermeans}

Categorize b-values into non-zero and b0 indices.

def segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, quantile: float = 0.995) -> dict[str, list[int]]: 
315def segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(image: ants.ANTsImage, quantile: float = 0.995) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
316    """Identify indices of a time series with higher and lower mean intensities across volumes."""
317    ishape = image.shape
318    lastdim = len(ishape) - 1
319    meanvalues = [ants.slice_image(image, axis=lastdim, idx=x).mean() for x in range(ishape[lastdim])]
320    myhiq = np.quantile(meanvalues, quantile)
321    myloq = np.quantile(meanvalues, 1.0 - quantile)
322    lowerindices: list[int] = []
323    higherindices: list[int] = []
324    for x, mv in enumerate(meanvalues):
325        hiabs = abs(mv - myhiq)
326        loabs = abs(mv - myloq)
327        if hiabs < loabs:
328            higherindices.append(x)
329        else:
330            lowerindices.append(x)
331    return {"lowermeans": lowerindices, "highermeans": higherindices}

Identify indices of a time series with higher and lower mean intensities across volumes.

def trim_dti_mask( fa: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, param: float = 4.0) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
551def trim_dti_mask(fa: ants.ANTsImage, mask: ants.ANTsImage, param: float = 4.0) -> ants.ANTsImage:
552    """Trim DTI mask to remove bright FA rim."""
553    spcmin = min(ants.get_spacing(mask))
554    param_vox = int(np.round(param / spcmin))
555    trim_mask = ants.image_clone(mask)
556    trim_mask = ants.iMath(trim_mask, "FillHoles")
557    edgemask = trim_mask - ants.iMath(trim_mask, "ME", param_vox)
558    maxk = 4
559    edgemask = ants.threshold_image(fa * edgemask, "Otsu", maxk)
560    edgemask = ants.threshold_image(edgemask, maxk - 1, maxk)
561    trim_mask[edgemask >= 1] = 0
562    trim_mask = ants.iMath(trim_mask, "ME", param_vox - 1)
563    trim_mask = ants.iMath(trim_mask, "GetLargestComponent")
564    trim_mask = ants.iMath(trim_mask, "MD", param_vox - 1)
565    return trim_mask

Trim DTI mask to remove bright FA rim.

def warn_if_small_mask( mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, threshold_fraction: float = 0.05, label: str = ' ') -> None: 
56def warn_if_small_mask(mask: ants.ANTsImage, threshold_fraction: float = 0.05, label: str = " ") -> None:
57    """Warn if the number of non-zero voxels in mask is below a fraction threshold."""
58    image_size = np.prod(mask.shape)
59    mask_size = np.count_nonzero(mask.numpy())
60    if mask_size / image_size < threshold_fraction:
61        percentage = 100.0 * mask_size / image_size
62        warnings.warn(
63            f"[ants] Warning: {label} contains only {mask_size} voxels ({percentage:.2f}%). "
64            f"Below {threshold_fraction * 100:.2f}%.",
65            UserWarning,
66        )

Warn if the number of non-zero voxels in mask is below a fraction threshold.

def wmh( flair: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1seg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mmfromconvexhull: float = 3.0, strict: bool = True, probability_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, prior_probability: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, model: str = 'sysu', verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
 27def wmh(
 28    flair: ants.ANTsImage,
 29    t1: ants.ANTsImage,
 30    t1seg: ants.ANTsImage,
 31    mmfromconvexhull: float = 3.0,
 32    strict: bool = True,
 33    probability_mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
 34    prior_probability: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
 35    model: str = "sysu",
 36    verbose: bool = False,
 37) -> dict[str, Any]:
 38    """Outputs WMH probability mask and summary volumetric measurement."""
 39    import antspynet
 40    import antspyt1w
 41
 42    t1_2_flair_reg = ants.registration(flair, t1, type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")
 43
 44    if probability_mask is None and model == "sysu":
 45        if verbose:
 46            print("sysu")
 47        probability_mask = antspynet.sysu_media_wmh_segmentation(flair)
 48    elif probability_mask is None and model == "hyper":
 49        if verbose:
 50            print("hyper")
 51        probability_mask = antspynet.hypermapp3r_segmentation(t1_2_flair_reg["warpedmovout"], flair)
 52
 53    prior_probability_flair = None
 54    if prior_probability is not None:
 55        prior_probability_flair = ants.apply_transforms(
 56            flair, prior_probability, t1_2_flair_reg["fwdtransforms"]
 57        )
 58
 59    wmseg_mask = ants.threshold_image(t1seg, low_thresh=3, high_thresh=3).iMath("FillHoles")
 60    wmseg_mask_use = ants.image_clone(wmseg_mask)
 61    distmask = None
 62
 63    if mmfromconvexhull > 0:
 64        convexhull = ants.threshold_image(t1seg, 1, 4)
 65        myspc = ants.get_spacing(t1seg)
 66        voxdist = math.sqrt(sum(s * s for s in myspc[: t1seg.dimension]))
 67        nmorph = round(2.0 / voxdist)
 68        convexhull = ants.morphology(convexhull, "close", nmorph).iMath("FillHoles")
 69        dist = ants.iMath(convexhull, "MaurerDistance") * -1.0
 70        distmask = ants.threshold_image(dist, mmfromconvexhull, 1.0e80)
 71        wmseg_mask = wmseg_mask + distmask
 72        wmseg_mask_use = (
 73            ants.threshold_image(wmseg_mask, 2, 2)
 74            if strict
 75            else ants.threshold_image(wmseg_mask, 1, 2)
 76        )
 77
 78    wmseg_2_flair = ants.apply_transforms(
 79        flair, wmseg_mask_use, transformlist=t1_2_flair_reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor"
 80    )
 81    seg_2_flair = ants.apply_transforms(
 82        flair, t1seg, transformlist=t1_2_flair_reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor"
 83    )
 84    csfmask = ants.threshold_image(seg_2_flair, 1, 1)
 85    flairsnr = mask_snr(flair, csfmask, wmseg_2_flair, bias_correct=False)
 86    probability_mask_wm = wmseg_2_flair * probability_mask
 87    wmh_sum = float(np.prod(ants.get_spacing(flair)) * probability_mask_wm.sum())
 88
 89    wmh_sum_prior = math.nan
 90    probability_mask_posterior = None
 91    if prior_probability_flair is not None:
 92        probability_mask_posterior = prior_probability_flair * probability_mask
 93        wmh_sum_prior = float(np.prod(ants.get_spacing(flair)) * probability_mask_posterior.sum())
 94
 95    if math.isnan(wmh_sum):
 96        wmh_sum = 0.0
 97    if math.isnan(wmh_sum_prior):
 98        wmh_sum_prior = 0.0
 99
100    flair_evr = antspyt1w.patch_eigenvalue_ratio(flair, 512, [16, 16, 16], evdepth=0.9, mask=wmseg_2_flair)
101
102    return {
103        "WMH_probability_map_raw": probability_mask,
104        "WMH_probability_map": probability_mask_wm,
105        "WMH_posterior_probability_map": probability_mask_posterior,
106        "wmh_mass": wmh_sum,
107        "wmh_mass_prior": wmh_sum_prior,
108        "wmh_evr": flair_evr,
109        "wmh_SNR": flairsnr,
110        "convexhull_mask": distmask,
111    }

Outputs WMH probability mask and summary volumetric measurement.

def dict_to_dataframe( data_dict: dict[str, typing.Any], convert_lists: bool = True, convert_arrays: bool = True, convert_images: bool = True, verbose: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame: 
20def dict_to_dataframe(
21    data_dict: dict[str, Any],
22    convert_lists: bool = True,
23    convert_arrays: bool = True,
24    convert_images: bool = True,
25    verbose: bool = False,
26) -> pd.DataFrame:
27    """Convert a dictionary to a pandas DataFrame, excluding non-scalar or non-convertible items."""
28    processed_data: dict[str, Any] = {}
29
30    def _mean_of_list(lst: list[Any]) -> float | None:
31        if not lst:
32            return 0.0
33        all_numeric = all(isinstance(item, (int, float)) for item in lst)
34        if all_numeric:
35            return sum(lst) / len(lst)
36        return None
37
38    for key, value in data_dict.items():
39        if isinstance(value, (int, float, str, bool)):
40            processed_data[key] = [value]
41        elif isinstance(value, list) and all(isinstance(item, (int, float, str, bool)) for item in value) and convert_lists:
42            meanvalue = _mean_of_list(value)
43            newkey = f"{key}_mean"
44            if verbose:
45                print(f" Key {key} is list with mean {meanvalue} -> {newkey}")
46            if newkey not in data_dict and convert_lists:
47                processed_data[newkey] = meanvalue
48        elif isinstance(value, np.ndarray) and all(isinstance(item, (int, float, str, bool)) for item in value) and convert_arrays:
49            meanvalue = float(value.mean())
50            newkey = f"{key}_mean"
51            if verbose:
52                print(f" Key {key} is nparray with mean {meanvalue} -> {newkey}")
53            if newkey not in data_dict:
54                processed_data[newkey] = meanvalue
55        elif isinstance(value, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) and convert_images:
56            meanvalue = float(value.mean())
57            newkey = f"{key}_mean"
58            if verbose:
59                print(f" Key {key} is antsimage with mean {meanvalue} -> {newkey}")
60            if newkey not in data_dict:
61                processed_data[newkey] = meanvalue
62            elif verbose:
63                print(f" Key {key} is antsimage with mean {meanvalue} but {newkey} already exists")
64
65    return pd.DataFrame.from_dict(processed_data)

Convert a dictionary to a pandas DataFrame, excluding non-scalar or non-convertible items.

def image_write_with_thumbnail( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fn: str, y: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, thumb: bool = True) -> None: 
68def image_write_with_thumbnail(
69    x: ants.ANTsImage,
70    fn: str,
71    y: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
72    thumb: bool = True,
73) -> None:
74    """Write an ANTsImage and optionally an orthopedic thumbnail PNG."""
75    ants.image_write(x, fn)
76    if not thumb or x.components > 1:
77        return
78
79    if x.dimension == 3:
80        thumb_fn = re.sub(r"\.nii\.gz$", "_3dthumb.png", fn)
81        try:
82            if y is None:
83                ants.plot_ortho(x, crop=True, filename=thumb_fn, flat=True, xyz_lines=False, orient_labels=False, xyz_pad=0)
84            else:
85                ants.plot_ortho(y, x, crop=True, filename=thumb_fn, flat=True, xyz_lines=False, orient_labels=False, xyz_pad=0)
86        except Exception:
87            pass
88    elif x.dimension == 4:
89        thumb_fn = re.sub(r"\.nii\.gz$", "_4dthumb.png", fn)
90        nslices = x.shape[3]
91        sl = int(min(round(nslices * 0.5), nslices - 1))
92        xview = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=sl)
93        try:
94            if y is None:
95                ants.plot_ortho(xview, crop=True, filename=thumb_fn, flat=True, xyz_lines=False, orient_labels=False, xyz_pad=0)
96            elif y.dimension == 3:
97                ants.plot_ortho(y, xview, crop=True, filename=thumb_fn, flat=True, xyz_lines=False, orient_labels=False, xyz_pad=0)
98        except Exception:
99            pass

def hierarchical_modality_summary( target_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, hier: dict[str, typing.Any], transformlist: list[str], modality_name: str, return_keys: list[str] | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame: 
207def hierarchical_modality_summary(
208    target_image: ants.ANTsImage,
209    hier: dict[str, Any],
210    transformlist: list[str],
211    modality_name: str,
212    return_keys: list[str] | None = None,
213    verbose: bool = False,
214) -> pd.DataFrame:
215    """Use output of antspyt1w.hierarchical to summarize a modality in wide format."""
216    import antspyt1w
217
218    if return_keys is None:
219        return_keys = ["Mean", "Volume"]
220    dfout = pd.DataFrame()
221
222    def _helper(target_img: ants.ANTsImage, seg: ants.ANTsImage, mytx: list[str], mapname: str, modname: str, mydf: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
223        target_mask = ants.image_clone(target_img) * 0.0
224        target_mask[target_img != 0] = 1.0
225        cortmapped = ants.apply_transforms(target_img, seg, mytx, interpolator="nearestNeighbor") * target_mask
226        mapped = antspyt1w.map_intensity_to_dataframe(
227            mapname,
228            target_img,
229            cortmapped,
230            labels=np.unique(seg.numpy()),
231            return_keys=return_keys,
232            modality_name=modname,
233        )
234        if mydf.shape[0] == 0:
235            return mapped
236        return pd.concat([mydf, mapped], axis=1, ignore_index=False)
237
238    dfout = _helper(target_image, hier["dkt_parc"]["dkt_cortex"], transformlist, "dkt_description", modality_name, dfout)
239    dfout = _helper(target_image, hier["dkt_parc"]["dkt_subcortical"], transformlist, "dkt_subcortical_description", modality_name, dfout)
240    dfout = _helper(target_image, hier["cit168lab"], transformlist, "cit168_description", modality_name, dfout)
241    return dfout

Use output of antspyt1w.hierarchical to summarize a modality in wide format.
