Convert an ANTsPy image to a Nibabel Nifti1Image in-memory, using correct spatial affine.

def ants_to_nibabel_affine(ants_img: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) -> numpy.ndarray: 
251def ants_to_nibabel_affine(ants_img: ants.ANTsImage) -> np.ndarray:
252    """Convert an ANTsPy image (in LPS space) to a Nibabel-compatible affine (in RAS space)."""
253    spatial_dim = ants_img.dimension
254    spacing = np.array(ants_img.spacing)
255    origin = np.array(ants_img.origin)
256    direction = np.array(ants_img.direction).reshape((spatial_dim, spatial_dim))
257    affine_linear = direction @ np.diag(spacing)
258    affine = np.eye(4)
259    affine[:spatial_dim, :spatial_dim] = affine_linear
260    affine[:spatial_dim, 3] = origin
261    affine[3, 3] = 1.0
262    lps_to_ras = np.diag([-1, -1, 1, 1])
263    affine = lps_to_ras @ affine
264    return affine

Convert an ANTsPy image (in LPS space) to a Nibabel-compatible affine (in RAS space).

def convert_np_in_dict(data_dict: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
302def convert_np_in_dict(data_dict: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
303    """Convert numpy float/int scalars in dictionary to standard Python float/int."""
304    converted_dict: dict[str, Any] = {}
305    for key, value in data_dict.items():
306        if isinstance(value, (np.float32, np.float64)):
307            converted_dict[key] = float(value)
308        elif isinstance(value, (np.int8, np.uint8, np.int16, np.uint16, np.int32, np.uint32, np.int64, np.uint64)):
309            converted_dict[key] = int(value)
310        else:
311            converted_dict[key] = value
312    return converted_dict

Convert numpy float/int scalars in dictionary to standard Python float/int.

def tsnr( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, indices: list[int] | None = None) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
347def tsnr(x: ants.ANTsImage, mask: ants.ANTsImage, indices: list[int] | None = None) -> ants.ANTsImage:
348    """3D temporal SNR image from a 4D time series image."""
349    m_mat = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(x, mask)
350    m_mat = m_mat - m_mat.min()
351    m_max = m_mat.max()
352    if m_max > 0:
353        m_mat = m_mat / m_max
354    if indices is not None:
355        m_mat = m_mat[indices, :]
356    std_m = np.std(m_mat, axis=0)
357    std_m[np.isnan(std_m)] = 0
358    return ants.make_image(mask, std_m)

3D temporal SNR image from a 4D time series image.

def dvars( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, indices: list[int] | None = None) -> numpy.ndarray: 
361def dvars(x: ants.ANTsImage, mask: ants.ANTsImage, indices: list[int] | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
362    """DVARS on a 4D time series image."""
363    m_mat = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(x, mask)
364    m_mat = m_mat - m_mat.min()
365    m_max = m_mat.max()
366    if m_max > 0:
367        m_mat = m_mat / m_max
368    if indices is not None:
369        m_mat = m_mat[indices, :]
370    n_pts = m_mat.shape[0]
371    dvars_arr = np.zeros(n_pts)
372    for i in range(1, n_pts):
373        vecdiff = m_mat[i - 1, :] - m_mat[i, :]
374        dvars_arr[i] = np.sqrt(np.mean(vecdiff * vecdiff))
375    if n_pts > 1:
376        dvars_arr[0] = float(np.mean(dvars_arr))
377    return dvars_arr

DVARS on a 4D time series image.

def slice_snr( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, background_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, foreground_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, indices: list[int] | None = None) -> numpy.ndarray: 
380def slice_snr(
381    x: ants.ANTsImage,
382    background_mask: ants.ANTsImage,
383    foreground_mask: ants.ANTsImage,
384    indices: list[int] | None = None,
385) -> np.ndarray:
386    """Slice-wise SNR on a time series image."""
387    xuse = ants.iMath(x, "Normalize")
388    mb = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(xuse, background_mask)
389    mf = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(xuse, foreground_mask)
390    if indices is not None:
391        mb = mb[indices, :]
392        mf = mf[indices, :]
393    ssnr = np.zeros(mb.shape[0])
394    for i in range(mb.shape[0]):
395        b_std = float(mb[i, :].std())
396        ssnr[i] = float(mf[i, :].mean()) / b_std if b_std > 0 else 0.0
397    ssnr[np.isnan(ssnr)] = 0
398    return ssnr

Slice-wise SNR on a time series image.

def middle_slice_snr(x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, background_dilation: int = 5) -> float: 
401def middle_slice_snr(x: ants.ANTsImage, background_dilation: int = 5) -> float:
402    """Estimate SNR in 2D mid-slice from a 3D image."""
403    xshp = x.shape
404    xmidslice = ants.slice_image(x, 2, int(xshp[2] / 2))
405    xmidslice = ants.iMath(xmidslice - xmidslice.min(), "Normalize")
406    xmidslice = ants.n3_bias_field_correction(xmidslice)
407    xmidslice = ants.n3_bias_field_correction(xmidslice)
408    xmidslicemask = ants.threshold_image(xmidslice, "Otsu", 1).morphology("close", 2).iMath("FillHoles")
409    xbkgmask = ants.iMath(xmidslicemask, "MD", background_dilation) - xmidslicemask
410    signal = float((xmidslice[xmidslicemask == 1]).mean())
411    noise = float((xmidslice[xbkgmask == 1]).std())
412    return signal / noise if noise > 0 else 0.0

Estimate SNR in 2D mid-slice from a 3D image.

def foreground_background_snr( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, background_dilation: int = 10, erode_foreground: bool = False) -> float: 
415def foreground_background_snr(x: ants.ANTsImage, background_dilation: int = 10, erode_foreground: bool = False) -> float:
416    """Estimate SNR in an image using foreground/background segmentation."""
417    xbc = ants.iMath(x - x.min(), "Normalize")
418    xbc = ants.n3_bias_field_correction(xbc)
419    xmask = ants.threshold_image(xbc, "Otsu", 1).morphology("close", 2).iMath("FillHoles")
420    xbkgmask = ants.iMath(xmask, "MD", background_dilation) - xmask
421    fgmask = xmask
422    if erode_foreground:
423        fgmask = ants.iMath(xmask, "ME", background_dilation)
424        xbkgmask = xmask - fgmask
425    signal = float((xbc[fgmask == 1]).mean())
426    noise = float((xbc[xbkgmask == 1]).std())
427    return signal / noise if noise > 0 else 0.0

Estimate SNR in an image using foreground/background segmentation.

def quantile_snr( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, lowest_quantile: float = 0.01, low_quantile: float = 0.1, high_quantile: float = 0.5, highest_quantile: float = 0.95) -> float: 
430def quantile_snr(
431    x: ants.ANTsImage,
432    lowest_quantile: float = 0.01,
433    low_quantile: float = 0.1,
434    high_quantile: float = 0.5,
435    highest_quantile: float = 0.95,
436) -> float:
437    """Estimate SNR in an image using intensity quantiles."""
438    xbc = ants.iMath(x - x.min(), "Normalize")
439    xbc = ants.n3_bias_field_correction(xbc)
440    xbc = ants.iMath(xbc - xbc.min(), "Normalize")
441    y = xbc.numpy()
442    y_pos = y[y > 0]
443    if len(y_pos) == 0:
444        return 0.0
445    ylowest = float(np.quantile(y_pos, lowest_quantile))
446    ylo = float(np.quantile(y_pos, low_quantile))
447    yhi = float(np.quantile(y_pos, high_quantile))
448    yhiest = float(np.quantile(y_pos, highest_quantile))
449    xbkgmask = ants.threshold_image(xbc, ylowest, ylo)
450    fgmask = ants.threshold_image(xbc, yhi, yhiest)
451    signal = float((xbc[fgmask == 1]).mean())
452    noise = float((xbc[xbkgmask == 1]).std())
453    return signal / noise if noise > 0 else 0.0

Estimate SNR in an image using intensity quantiles.

def mask_snr( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, background_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, foreground_mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bias_correct: bool = True) -> float: 
456def mask_snr(x: ants.ANTsImage, background_mask: ants.ANTsImage, foreground_mask: ants.ANTsImage, bias_correct: bool = True) -> float:
457    """Estimate SNR using user-defined foreground and background masks."""
458    if foreground_mask.sum() <= 1 or background_mask.sum() <= 1:
459        return 0.0
460    xbc = ants.iMath(x - x.min(), "Normalize")
461    if bias_correct:
462        xbc = ants.n3_bias_field_correction(xbc)
463    xbc = ants.iMath(xbc - xbc.min(), "Normalize")
464    signal = float((xbc[foreground_mask == 1]).mean())
465    noise = float((xbc[background_mask == 1]).std())
466    return signal / noise if noise > 0 else 0.0

Estimate SNR using user-defined foreground and background masks.

def flatten_time_series(time_series: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray: 
488def flatten_time_series(time_series: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
489    """Flatten a 4D time series into a 2D array (n_time_points x n_voxels)."""
490    n_volumes = time_series.shape[3]
491    return time_series.reshape(-1, n_volumes).T

Flatten a 4D time series into a 2D array (n_time_points x n_voxels).

def calculate_loop_scores( flattened_series: numpy.ndarray, n_neighbors: int = 20, n_features_sample: int | float = 0.02, n_feature_repeats: int = 5, seed: int = 42, use_approx_knn: bool = True, verbose: bool = True) -> numpy.ndarray: 
513def calculate_loop_scores(
514    flattened_series: np.ndarray,
515    n_neighbors: int = 20,
516    n_features_sample: int | float = 0.02,
517    n_feature_repeats: int = 5,
518    seed: int = 42,
519    use_approx_knn: bool = True,
520    verbose: bool = True,
521) -> np.ndarray:
522    """Memory-efficient LoOP score estimation with feature subsampling."""
523    from PyNomaly import loop
524    from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
525
526    try:
527        from pynndescent import NNDescent
528        has_nn_descent = True
529    except ImportError:
530        has_nn_descent = False
531
532    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
533    X = np.nan_to_num(flattened_series, nan=0).astype(np.float32)
534    n_samples, n_features = X.shape
535
536    if isinstance(n_features_sample, float):
537        if 0 < n_features_sample <= 1.0:
538            n_features_sample = max(1, int(n_features_sample * n_features))
539        else:
540            raise ValueError("If float, n_features_sample must be in (0, 1].")
541
542    n_features_sample = min(n_features, int(n_features_sample))
543    if n_neighbors >= n_samples:
544        n_neighbors = max(1, n_samples // 2)
545
546    loop_scores = []
547    for rep in range(n_feature_repeats):
548        feature_idx = rng.choice(n_features, n_features_sample, replace=False)
549        X_sub = X[:, feature_idx]
550        scaler = StandardScaler(copy=False)
551        X_sub = scaler.fit_transform(X_sub)
552        X_sub = np.nan_to_num(X_sub, nan=0)
553
554        if use_approx_knn and has_nn_descent and n_samples > 1000:
555            ann = NNDescent(X_sub, n_neighbors=n_neighbors, random_state=seed + rep)
556            indices, dists = ann.neighbor_graph
557        else:
558            from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
559            nn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=n_neighbors)
560            nn.fit(X_sub)
561            dists, indices = nn.kneighbors(X_sub)
562
563        model = loop.LocalOutlierProbability(
564            distance_matrix=dists,
565            neighbor_matrix=indices,
566            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
567        ).fit()
568        loop_scores.append(model.local_outlier_probabilities[:])
569
570    return np.mean(np.stack(loop_scores), axis=0)

Memory-efficient LoOP score estimation with feature subsampling.

def calculate_loop_scores_full( flattened_series: numpy.ndarray, n_neighbors: int = 20, verbose: bool = True) -> numpy.ndarray: 
494def calculate_loop_scores_full(flattened_series: np.ndarray, n_neighbors: int = 20, verbose: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
495    """Calculate Local Outlier Probabilities for each volume."""
496    from PyNomaly import loop
497    from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
498    from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
499
500    flattened_series = np.nan_to_num(flattened_series, nan=0)
501    scaler = StandardScaler()
502    data = scaler.fit_transform(flattened_series)
503    data = np.nan_to_num(data, nan=0)
504    if n_neighbors > int(flattened_series.shape[0] / 2.0):
505        n_neighbors = max(1, int(flattened_series.shape[0] / 2.0))
506    neigh = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=n_neighbors, metric="minkowski")
507    neigh.fit(data)
508    d, idx = neigh.kneighbors(data, return_distance=True)
509    m = loop.LocalOutlierProbability(distance_matrix=d, neighbor_matrix=idx, n_neighbors=n_neighbors).fit()
510    return m.local_outlier_probabilities[:]

Calculate Local Outlier Probabilities for each volume.

def remove_elements_from_numpy_array( original_array: numpy.ndarray | None, indices_to_remove: list[int] | numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray | None: 
573def remove_elements_from_numpy_array(original_array: np.ndarray | None, indices_to_remove: list[int] | np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray | None:
574    """Remove specified elements or rows from a numpy array."""
575    if original_array is None:
576        return None
577    if original_array.ndim == 1:
578        return np.delete(original_array, indices_to_remove)
579    elif original_array.ndim == 2:
580        return np.delete(original_array, indices_to_remove, axis=0)
581    raise ValueError("original_array must be either 1D or 2D.")

Remove specified elements or rows from a numpy array.

def remove_volumes_from_timeseries( time_series: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, volumes_to_remove: list[int] | numpy.ndarray) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
584def remove_volumes_from_timeseries(time_series: ants.ANTsImage, volumes_to_remove: list[int] | np.ndarray) -> ants.ANTsImage:
585    """Remove specified volumes from a 4D time series."""
586    if not isinstance(time_series, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage):
587        raise ValueError("time_series must be an ANTsImage.")
588    if time_series.dimension != 4:
589        raise ValueError("time_series must be a 4D image.")
590    remove_set = set(volumes_to_remove)
591    volumes_to_keep = [i for i in range(time_series.shape[3]) if i not in remove_set]
592    filtered_time_series = ants.from_numpy(time_series.numpy()[..., volumes_to_keep])
593    return ants.copy_image_info(time_series, filtered_time_series)

Remove specified volumes from a 4D time series.

def remove_elements_from_list( original_list: list[typing.Any], elements_to_remove: list[typing.Any]) -> list[typing.Any]: 
596def remove_elements_from_list(original_list: list[Any], elements_to_remove: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
597    """Remove specified elements from a list."""
598    remove_set = set(elements_to_remove)

Remove specified elements from a list.

def impute_timeseries( time_series: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, volumes_to_impute: list[int], method: str = 'linear', verbose: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
602def impute_timeseries(
603    time_series: ants.ANTsImage,
604    volumes_to_impute: list[int],
605    method: str = "linear",
606    verbose: bool = False,
607) -> ants.ANTsImage:
608    """Impute specified volumes from a time series with interpolated values."""
609    if not isinstance(time_series, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage):
610        raise ValueError("time_series must be an ANTsImage.")
611    if time_series.dimension != 4:
612        raise ValueError("time_series must be a 4D image.")
613
614    time_series_np = time_series.numpy()
615    total_volumes = time_series_np.shape[3]
616    volumes_not_to_impute = [i for i in range(total_volumes) if i not in set(volumes_to_impute)]
617    if not volumes_not_to_impute:
618        return time_series
619
620    min_valid_index = min(volumes_not_to_impute)
621    max_valid_index = max(volumes_not_to_impute)
622
623    for vol_idx in volumes_to_impute:
624        if vol_idx < 0 or vol_idx >= total_volumes:
625            raise ValueError(f"Volume index {vol_idx} is out of bounds.")
626        lower_candidates = [v for v in volumes_not_to_impute if v <= vol_idx]
627        lower_idx = max(lower_candidates) if lower_candidates else min_valid_index
628        upper_candidates = [v for v in volumes_not_to_impute if v >= vol_idx]
629        upper_idx = min(upper_candidates) if upper_candidates else max_valid_index
630
631        if method == "linear":
632            lower_volume = time_series_np[..., lower_idx]
633            upper_volume = time_series_np[..., upper_idx]
634            time_series_np[..., vol_idx] = (lower_volume + upper_volume) / 2.0
635        else:
636            raise NotImplementedError("Currently, only linear interpolation is implemented.")
637
638    imputed_time_series = ants.from_numpy(time_series_np)
639    return ants.copy_image_info(time_series, imputed_time_series)

Impute specified volumes from a time series with interpolated values.

def loop_timeseries_censoring( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, threshold: float = 0.5, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, n_features_sample: int | float = 0.02, seed: int = 42, verbose: bool = True) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray]: 
642def loop_timeseries_censoring(
643    x: ants.ANTsImage,
644    threshold: float = 0.5,
645    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
646    n_features_sample: int | float = 0.02,
647    seed: int = 42,
648    verbose: bool = True,
649) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray]:
650    """Censor high leverage volumes from a time series using LoOP."""
651    if x.shape[3] < 20:
652        warnings.warn("Warning: the time dimension is < 20 - too few samples for loop.")
653        return x, np.array([], dtype=int)
654    if mask is None:
655        flattened_series = flatten_time_series(x.numpy())
656    else:
657        flattened_series = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(x, mask)
658    loop_scores = calculate_loop_scores(flattened_series, n_features_sample=n_features_sample, seed=seed, verbose=verbose)
659    high_leverage_volumes = np.where(loop_scores > threshold)[0]
660    new_ts = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(x, high_leverage_volumes)
661    return new_ts, high_leverage_volumes

Censor high leverage volumes from a time series using LoOP.

def score_fmri_censoring( cbfts: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, csf_seg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, gm_seg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, wm_seg: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray]: 
664def score_fmri_censoring(
665    cbfts: ants.ANTsImage,
666    csf_seg: ants.ANTsImage,
667    gm_seg: ants.ANTsImage,
668    wm_seg: ants.ANTsImage,
669) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray]:
670    """Process CBF time series to remove high-leverage points via SCORE."""
671    n_gm_voxels = float(np.sum(gm_seg.numpy())) - 1
672    n_wm_voxels = float(np.sum(wm_seg.numpy())) - 1
673    n_csf_voxels = float(np.sum(csf_seg.numpy())) - 1
674    mask1img = gm_seg + wm_seg + csf_seg
675
676    cbfts_np = cbfts.numpy()
677    gmbool = (gm_seg == 1).numpy()
678    csfbool = (csf_seg == 1).numpy()
679    wmbool = (wm_seg == 1).numpy()
680    gm_cbf_ts = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(cbfts, gm_seg)
681    gm_cbf_ts = np.squeeze(np.mean(gm_cbf_ts, axis=1))
682
683    median_gm_cbf = float(np.median(gm_cbf_ts))
684    mad_gm_cbf = float(np.median(np.abs(gm_cbf_ts - median_gm_cbf))) / 0.675
685    indx = np.abs(gm_cbf_ts - median_gm_cbf) > (2.5 * mad_gm_cbf)
686
687    spatmeannp = np.mean(cbfts_np[:, :, :, ~indx], axis=3)
688    spatmean = ants.from_numpy(spatmeannp)
689    V = (
690        n_gm_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[gmbool])
691        + n_wm_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[wmbool])
692        + n_csf_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[csfbool])
693    )
694    V1 = math.inf
695    while V < V1:
696        V1 = V
697        CC = np.zeros(cbfts_np.shape[3])
698        for s in range(cbfts_np.shape[3]):
699            if indx[s]:
700                continue
701            tmp1 = ants.from_numpy(cbfts_np[:, :, :, s])
702            CC[s] = ants.image_similarity(spatmean, tmp1, metric_type="Correlation", fixed_mask=mask1img)
703        inx = int(np.argmin(CC))
704        indx[inx] = True
705        spatmeannp = np.mean(cbfts_np[:, :, :, ~indx], axis=3)
706        spatmean = ants.from_numpy(spatmeannp)
707        V = (
708            n_gm_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[gmbool])
709            + n_wm_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[wmbool])
710            + n_csf_voxels * np.var(spatmeannp[csfbool])
711        )
712    cbfts_recon = cbfts_np[:, :, :, ~indx]
713    cbfts_recon = np.nan_to_num(cbfts_recon)
714    cbfts_recon_ants = ants.from_numpy(cbfts_recon)
715    cbfts_recon_ants = ants.copy_image_info(cbfts, cbfts_recon_ants)
716    return cbfts_recon_ants, indx

Process CBF time series to remove high-leverage points via SCORE.

def write_bvals_bvecs(bvals: Any, bvecs: Any, prefix: str) -> None: 
40def write_bvals_bvecs(bvals: Any, bvecs: Any, prefix: str) -> None:
41    """Write FSL FDT bvals and bvecs files."""
42    val_fmt = "   %e"
43    bvals_tuple = tuple(bvals)
44    bvecs_arr = np.asarray(bvecs)
45    bvecs_arr[np.isnan(bvecs_arr)] = 0
46    n = len(bvals_tuple)
47
48    fname_bval = prefix + ".bval"
49    fmt = val_fmt * n + "\n"
50    with open(fname_bval, "wt") as f:
51        f.write(fmt % bvals_tuple)
52
53    fname_bvec = prefix + ".bvec"
54    with open(fname_bvec, "wt") as f:
55        for dim_vals in bvecs_arr.T:
56            f.write(fmt % tuple(dim_vals))

Write FSL FDT bvals and bvecs files.

def repair_bvecs(bvecs: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray: 
59def repair_bvecs(bvecs: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
60    """Normalize bvecs if needed."""
61    bvecs_arr = np.asarray(bvecs)
62    bvecnorm = np.linalg.norm(bvecs_arr, axis=1).reshape(bvecs_arr.shape[0], 1)
63    if abs(np.linalg.norm(bvecs_arr) - 1) > 0.009:
64        warnings.warn(
65            f"Warning: bvecs are not unit norm - normalizing. Norm: {np.linalg.norm(bvecs_arr)}"
66        )
67        bvecs_arr = np.where(bvecnorm > 1e-16, bvecs_arr / bvecnorm, 0)
68    return bvecs_arr

Normalize bvecs if needed.

def triangular_to_tensor( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, upper_triangular: bool = True) -> numpy.ndarray: 
71def triangular_to_tensor(image: ants.ANTsImage, upper_triangular: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
72    """Convert triangular tensor image to a full tensor form (in numpy X, Y, Z, 3, 3)."""
73    yyind = 3 if upper_triangular else 2
74    xzind = 2 if upper_triangular else 3
75    dtinp = np.zeros(image.shape + (3, 3), dtype=float)
76    dtix = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=float)
77    dtiut = image.numpy()
78    for i in np.ndindex(image.shape):
79        dtivec = dtiut[i]
80        dtix[0, 0] = dtivec[0]
81        dtix[1, 1] = dtivec[yyind]
82        dtix[2, 2] = dtivec[5]
83        dtix[0, 1] = dtix[1, 0] = dtivec[1]
84        dtix[0, 2] = dtix[2, 0] = dtivec[xzind]
85        dtix[1, 2] = dtix[2, 1] = dtivec[4]
86        dtinp[i] = dtix
87    return dtinp

Convert triangular tensor image to a full tensor form (in numpy X, Y, Z, 3, 3).

def dti_numpy_to_image( reference_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, tensorarray: numpy.ndarray, upper_triangular: bool = True) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
 90def dti_numpy_to_image(reference_image: ants.ANTsImage, tensorarray: np.ndarray, upper_triangular: bool = True) -> ants.ANTsImage:
 91    """Convert numpy DTI data (X, Y, Z, 3, 3) to 6-component ANTsImage."""
 92    dtiut = np.zeros(reference_image.shape + (6,), dtype=float)
 93    dtivec = np.zeros(6, dtype=float)
 94    yyind = 3 if upper_triangular else 2
 95    xzind = 2 if upper_triangular else 3
 96    for i in np.ndindex(reference_image.shape):
 97        dtix = tensorarray[i]
 98        dtivec[0] = dtix[0, 0]
 99        dtivec[yyind] = dtix[1, 1]
100        dtivec[5] = dtix[2, 2]
101        dtivec[1] = dtix[0, 1]
102        dtivec[xzind] = dtix[2, 0]
103        dtivec[4] = dtix[1, 2]
104        dtiut[i] = dtivec
105    dti_ants = ants.from_numpy(dtiut, has_components=True)
106    ants.copy_image_info(reference_image, dti_ants)
107    return dti_ants

Convert numpy DTI data (X, Y, Z, 3, 3) to 6-component ANTsImage.

def get_dti( reference_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, tensormodel: Any, upper_triangular: bool = True, return_image: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | numpy.ndarray: 
110def get_dti(
111    reference_image: ants.ANTsImage,
112    tensormodel: Any,
113    upper_triangular: bool = True,
114    return_image: bool = False,
115) -> ants.ANTsImage | np.ndarray:
116    """Extract DTI data from a dipy tensormodel."""
117    reoind = np.array([0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5])
118    dtiut = dti.lower_triangular(tensormodel.quadratic_form)
119    yyind = 3 if upper_triangular else 2
120    xzind = 2 if upper_triangular else 3
121    if upper_triangular:
122        for i in np.ndindex(reference_image.shape):
123            dtiut[i] = dtiut[i][reoind]
124    if return_image:
125        dti_ants = ants.from_numpy(dtiut, has_components=True)
126        ants.copy_image_info(reference_image, dti_ants)
127        return dti_ants
128
129    dtinp = np.zeros(reference_image.shape + (3, 3), dtype=float)
130    dtix = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=float)
131    for i in np.ndindex(reference_image.shape):
132        dtivec = dtiut[i]
133        dtix[0, 0] = dtivec[0]
134        dtix[1, 1] = dtivec[yyind]
135        dtix[2, 2] = dtivec[5]
136        dtix[0, 1] = dtix[1, 0] = dtivec[1]
137        dtix[0, 2] = dtix[2, 0] = dtivec[xzind]
138        dtix[1, 2] = dtix[2, 1] = dtivec[4]
139        dtinp[i] = dtix
140    return dtinp

Extract DTI data from a dipy tensormodel.

def impute_fa( fa: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, md: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
568def impute_fa(fa: ants.ANTsImage, md: ants.ANTsImage) -> ants.ANTsImage:
569    """Impute bad values in FA and MD images."""
570    def _impute(x: ants.ANTsImage, ref_fa: ants.ANTsImage) -> ants.ANTsImage:
571        badfa = ants.threshold_image(ref_fa, 1, 1)
572        if badfa.max() == 1:
573            temp = ants.image_clone(x)
574            temp[badfa == 1] = 0
575            temp = ants.iMath(temp, "GD", 2)
576            x[badfa == 1] = temp[badfa == 1]
577        return x
578    return _impute(md, fa)

Impute bad values in FA and MD images.

def impute_dwi( dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, threshold: float = 0.2, imputeb0: bool = False, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
581def impute_dwi(
582    dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
583    threshold: float = 0.20,
584    imputeb0: bool = False,
585    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
586    verbose: bool = False,
587) -> ants.ANTsImage:
588    """Identify bad volumes in DWI and impute them automatically."""
589    list1 = segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(dwi)["highermeans"]
590    if imputeb0:
591        dwib = impute_timeseries(dwi, list1)
592        _, list2 = loop_timeseries_censoring(dwib, threshold, mask)
593    else:
594        _, list2 = loop_timeseries_censoring(dwi, threshold, mask)
595    complement = remove_elements_from_list(list(list2), list1)
596    if not complement:
597        return dwi
598    return impute_timeseries(dwi, complement)

Identify bad volumes in DWI and impute them automatically.

def censor_dwi( dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bval: numpy.ndarray, bvec: numpy.ndarray, threshold: float = 0.2, imputeb0: bool = False, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]: 
601def censor_dwi(
602    dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
603    bval: np.ndarray,
604    bvec: np.ndarray,
605    threshold: float = 0.20,
606    imputeb0: bool = False,
607    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
608    verbose: bool = False,
609) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
610    """Identify bad volumes in DWI and censor them."""
611    list1 = segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(dwi)["highermeans"]
612    if imputeb0:
613        dwib = impute_timeseries(dwi, list1)
614        _, list2 = loop_timeseries_censoring(dwib, threshold, mask, verbose=verbose)
615    else:
616        _, list2 = loop_timeseries_censoring(dwi, threshold, mask, verbose=verbose)
617    complement = remove_elements_from_list(list(list2), list1)
618    if not complement:
619        return dwi, bval, bvec
620    return (
621        remove_volumes_from_timeseries(dwi, complement),
622        remove_elements_from_numpy_array(bval, complement),
623        remove_elements_from_numpy_array(bvec, complement),
624    )

Identify bad volumes in DWI and censor them.

def merge_dwi_data( img_lrdwp: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bval_lr: numpy.ndarray, bvec_lr: numpy.ndarray, img_rldwp: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bval_rl: numpy.ndarray, bvec_rl: numpy.ndarray) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]: 
627def merge_dwi_data(
628    img_lrdwp: ants.ANTsImage,
629    bval_lr: np.ndarray,
630    bvec_lr: np.ndarray,
631    img_rldwp: ants.ANTsImage,
632    bval_rl: np.ndarray,
633    bvec_rl: np.ndarray,
634) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
635    """Merge motion and distortion corrected DWI acquisitions."""
636    if not ants.image_physical_space_consistency(img_lrdwp, img_rldwp):
637        warnings.warn("Corrected image pair must occupy the same physical space; returning 1st only.")
638        return img_lrdwp, bval_lr, bvec_lr
639
640    bvals = np.concatenate([bval_lr, bval_rl])
641    bvecs = np.concatenate([bvec_lr, bvec_rl])
642    mimg = [ants.slice_image(img_lrdwp, axis=3, idx=k) for k in range(img_lrdwp.shape[3])]
643    mimg += [ants.slice_image(img_rldwp, axis=3, idx=k) for k in range(img_rldwp.shape[3])]
644    return ants.list_to_ndimage(img_lrdwp, mimg), bvals, bvecs

Merge motion and distortion corrected DWI acquisitions.

def mc_denoise( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ratio: float = 0.5) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
647def mc_denoise(x: ants.ANTsImage, ratio: float = 0.5) -> ants.ANTsImage:
648    """ANTs denoising for 4D timeseries."""
649    dwpimage = []
650    for myidx in range(x.shape[3]):
651        b0 = ants.slice_image(x, axis=3, idx=myidx)
652        dnzb0 = ants.denoise_image(b0, p=1, r=1, noise_model="Gaussian")
653        dwpimage.append(dnzb0 * ratio + b0 * (1.0 - ratio))
654    return ants.list_to_ndimage(x, dwpimage)

ANTs denoising for 4D timeseries.

def efficient_tensor_fit( gtab: Any, fit_method: str, imagein: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, maskin: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, diffusion_model: str = 'DTI', chunk_size: int = 10, num_threads: int = 1, verbose: bool = True) -> tuple[typing.Any, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
657def efficient_tensor_fit(
658    gtab: Any,
659    fit_method: str,
660    imagein: ants.ANTsImage,
661    maskin: ants.ANTsImage,
662    diffusion_model: str = "DTI",
663    chunk_size: int = 10,
664    num_threads: int = 1,
665    verbose: bool = True,
666) -> tuple[Any, ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage]:
667    """Efficient and optionally parallelized tensor reconstruction using DiPy."""
668    assert imagein.dimension == 4, "Input image must be 4D"
669
670    img_data = imagein.numpy()
671    mask = maskin.numpy().astype(bool)
672    X, Y, Z, _ = img_data.shape
673
674    model = fwdti.FreeWaterTensorModel(gtab) if diffusion_model == "FreeWater" else dti.TensorModel(gtab, fit_method=fit_method)
675
676    def process_chunk(z_start: int) -> tuple[int, int, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
677        z_end = min(Z, z_start + chunk_size)
678        local_data = img_data[:, :, z_start:z_end, :]
679        local_mask = mask[:, :, z_start:z_end]
680        masked_data = np.nan_to_num(local_data * local_mask[..., None], nan=0)
681        fit = model.fit(masked_data)
682        fa_chunk = fractional_anisotropy(fit.evals)
683        fa_chunk[np.isnan(fa_chunk)] = 1
684        fa_chunk = np.clip(fa_chunk, 0, 1)
685        md_chunk = mean_diffusivity(fit.evals)
686        rgb_chunk = color_fa(fa_chunk, fit.evecs)
687        return z_start, z_end, fa_chunk, md_chunk, rgb_chunk
688
689    fa_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
690    md_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
691    rgb_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z, 3), dtype=np.float32)
692
693    chunks = range(0, Z, chunk_size)
694    if num_threads > 1:
695        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=num_threads) as executor:
696            futures = {executor.submit(process_chunk, z): z for z in chunks}
697            for f in as_completed(futures):
698                z_s, z_e, fa_c, md_c, rgb_c = f.result()
699                fa_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = fa_c
700                md_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = md_c
701                rgb_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e, :] = rgb_c
702    else:
703        for z in chunks:
704            z_s, z_e, fa_c, md_c, rgb_c = process_chunk(z)
705            fa_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = fa_c
706            md_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = md_c
707            rgb_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e, :] = rgb_c
708
709    b0 = ants.slice_image(imagein, axis=3, idx=0)
710    fa_img = ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(fa_vol))
711    md_img = ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(md_vol))
712    rgb_img = ants.merge_channels([ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(rgb_vol[..., i])) for i in range(3)])
713    return model.fit(img_data * mask[..., None]), fa_img, md_img, rgb_img

Efficient and optionally parallelized tensor reconstruction using DiPy.

def efficient_dwi_fit( gtab: Any, diffusion_model: str, imagein: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, maskin: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, model_params: dict[str, typing.Any] | None = None, bvals_to_use: list[int] | None = None, chunk_size: int = 1024, num_threads: int = 1, verbose: bool = True) -> tuple[typing.Any, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None]: 
716def efficient_dwi_fit(
717    gtab: Any,
718    diffusion_model: str,
719    imagein: ants.ANTsImage,
720    maskin: ants.ANTsImage,
721    model_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
722    bvals_to_use: list[int] | None = None,
723    chunk_size: int = 1024,
724    num_threads: int = 1,
725    verbose: bool = True,
726) -> tuple[Any, ants.ANTsImage | None, ants.ANTsImage | None, ants.ANTsImage | None]:
727    """Efficient parallelized diffusion model fitting."""
728    import dipy.reconst.dki as dki
729
730    assert imagein.dimension == 4, "Input image must be 4D"
731    model_params = model_params or {}
732
733    img_data = imagein.numpy()
734    mask = maskin.numpy().astype(bool)
735    X, Y, Z, N = img_data.shape
736    inplane_size = X * Y
737    slices_per_chunk = max(1, chunk_size // inplane_size)
738
739    if bvals_to_use is not None:
740        bvals_set = set(bvals_to_use)
741        sel = np.isin(gtab.bvals, list(bvals_set))
742        img_data = img_data[..., sel]
743        gtab = gradient_table(gtab.bvals[sel], bvecs=gtab.bvecs[sel])
744
745    if diffusion_model == "DTI":
746        model = dti.TensorModel(gtab, **model_params)
747    elif diffusion_model == "FreeWater":
748        model = fwdti.FreeWaterTensorModel(gtab)
749    elif diffusion_model == "DKI":
750        model = dki.DiffusionKurtosisModel(gtab, **model_params)
751    else:
752        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported model: {diffusion_model}")
753
754    has_tensor_metrics = diffusion_model in ["DTI", "FreeWater"]
755    fa_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
756    md_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
757    rgb_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z, 3), dtype=np.float32)
758
759    def process_chunk(z_start: int) -> tuple[int, int, np.ndarray | None, np.ndarray | None, np.ndarray | None]:
760        z_end = min(Z, z_start + slices_per_chunk)
761        local_data = img_data[:, :, z_start:z_end, :]
762        local_mask = mask[:, :, z_start:z_end]
763        masked_data = np.nan_to_num(local_data * local_mask[..., None], nan=0)
764        fit = model.fit(masked_data)
765        if has_tensor_metrics and hasattr(fit, "evals") and hasattr(fit, "evecs"):
766            fa = fractional_anisotropy(fit.evals)
767            fa[np.isnan(fa)] = 1
768            fa = np.clip(fa, 0, 1)
769            md = mean_diffusivity(fit.evals)
770            rgb = color_fa(fa, fit.evecs)
771            return z_start, z_end, fa, md, rgb
772        return z_start, z_end, None, None, None
773
774    chunks = range(0, Z, slices_per_chunk)
775    if num_threads > 1:
776        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=num_threads) as executor:
777            futures = {executor.submit(process_chunk, z): z for z in chunks}
778            for f in as_completed(futures):
779                z_s, z_e, fa, md, rgb = f.result()
780                if fa is not None:
781                    fa_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = fa
782                    md_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = md
783                    rgb_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e, :] = rgb
784    else:
785        for z in chunks:
786            z_s, z_e, fa, md, rgb = process_chunk(z)
787            if fa is not None:
788                fa_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = fa
789                md_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e] = md
790                rgb_vol[:, :, z_s:z_e, :] = rgb
791
792    b0 = ants.slice_image(imagein, axis=3, idx=0)
793    fa_img = ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(fa_vol)) if has_tensor_metrics else None
794    md_img = ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(md_vol)) if has_tensor_metrics else None
795    rgb_img = (
796        ants.merge_channels([ants.copy_image_info(b0, ants.from_numpy(rgb_vol[..., i])) for i in range(3)])
797        if has_tensor_metrics
798        else None
799    )
800    full_fit = model.fit(img_data * mask[..., None])
801    return full_fit, fa_img, md_img, rgb_img

Efficient parallelized diffusion model fitting.

def efficient_dwi_fit_voxelwise( imagein: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, maskin: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bvals: numpy.ndarray, bvecs_5d: numpy.ndarray, model_params: dict[str, typing.Any] | None = None, bvals_to_use: list[int] | None = None, num_threads: int = 1, verbose: bool = True) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
804def efficient_dwi_fit_voxelwise(
805    imagein: ants.ANTsImage,
806    maskin: ants.ANTsImage,
807    bvals: np.ndarray,
808    bvecs_5d: np.ndarray,
809    model_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
810    bvals_to_use: list[int] | None = None,
811    num_threads: int = 1,
812    verbose: bool = True,
813) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage, ants.ANTsImage]:
814    """Voxel-wise diffusion model fitting with individual b-vectors per voxel."""
815    from tqdm import tqdm
816
817    model_params = model_params or {}
818    img = imagein.numpy()
819    mask = maskin.numpy().astype(bool)
820    X, Y, Z, _ = img.shape
821
822    if bvals_to_use is not None:
823        sel = np.isin(bvals, bvals_to_use)
824        img = img[..., sel]
825        bvals = bvals[sel]
826        bvecs_5d = bvecs_5d[..., sel, :]
827
828    fa_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
829    md_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z), dtype=np.float32)
830    rgb_vol = np.zeros((X, Y, Z, 3), dtype=np.float32)
831
832    def fit_voxel(ix: int, iy: int, iz: int) -> None:
833        if not mask[ix, iy, iz]:
834            return
835        sig = img[ix, iy, iz, :]
836        if np.all(sig == 0):
837            return
838        bv = bvecs_5d[ix, iy, iz, :, :]
839        gtab = gradient_table(bvals, bvecs=bv)
840        try:
841            model = dti.TensorModel(gtab, **model_params)
842            fit = model.fit(sig)
843            fa_vol[ix, iy, iz] = fractional_anisotropy(fit.evals)
844            md_vol[ix, iy, iz] = mean_diffusivity(fit.evals)
845            rgb_vol[ix, iy, iz, :] = color_fa(fa_vol[ix, iy, iz], fit.evecs)
846        except Exception:
847            pass
848
849    coords = np.argwhere(mask)
850    if num_threads > 1:
851        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=num_threads) as executor:
852            list(tqdm(executor.map(lambda c: fit_voxel(*c), coords), total=len(coords), disable=not verbose))
853    else:
854        for c in tqdm(coords, disable=not verbose):
855            fit_voxel(*c)
856
857    ref = ants.slice_image(imagein, axis=3, idx=0)
858    return (
859        ants.copy_image_info(ref, ants.from_numpy(fa_vol)),
860        ants.copy_image_info(ref, ants.from_numpy(md_vol)),
861        ants.merge_channels([ants.copy_image_info(ref, ants.from_numpy(rgb_vol[..., i])) for i in range(3)]),
862    )

Voxel-wise diffusion model fitting with individual b-vectors per voxel.

def dipy_dti_recon( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bvalsfn: Any, bvecsfn: Any, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, b0_idx: list[int] | None = None, mask_dilation: int = 2, mask_closing: int = 5, fit_method: str = 'WLS', trim_the_mask: float = 2.0, diffusion_model: str = 'DTI', verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
865def dipy_dti_recon(
866    image: ants.ANTsImage,
867    bvalsfn: Any,
868    bvecsfn: Any,
869    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
870    b0_idx: list[int] | None = None,
871    mask_dilation: int = 2,
872    mask_closing: int = 5,
873    fit_method: str = "WLS",
874    trim_the_mask: float = 2.0,
875    diffusion_model: str = "DTI",
876    verbose: bool = False,
877) -> dict[str, Any]:
878    """DiPy DTI reconstruction."""
879    import antspynet
880
881    if isinstance(bvecsfn, str):
882        bvals, bvecs = read_bvals_bvecs(bvalsfn, bvecsfn)
883    else:
884        bvals = bvalsfn.copy()
885        bvecs = bvecsfn.copy()
886
887    if bvals.max() < 1.0:
888        raise ValueError("DTI recon error: maximum bvalues are too small.")
889
890    b0_idx = segment_timeseries_by_bvalue(bvals)["lowbvals"]
891    b0 = ants.slice_image(image, axis=3, idx=b0_idx[0])
892    constant_mask = False
893
894    if mask is not None:
895        constant_mask = True

897    else:
898        mask = antspynet.brain_extraction(b0, "t2").threshold_image(0.5, 1).iMath("GetLargestComponent").morphology("close", 2).iMath("FillHoles")
899
900    if mask_closing > 0 and not constant_mask:
901        mask = ants.morphology(mask, "close", mask_closing)
902    maskdil = ants.iMath(mask, "MD", mask_dilation)
903
904    bvecs = repair_bvecs(bvecs)
905    gtab = gradient_table(bvals, bvecs=bvecs, atol=2.0)
906    mynt = int(os.environ.get("ITK_GLOBAL_DEFAULT_NUMBER_OF_THREADS", 1))
907
908    tenfit, fa, md1, rgb = efficient_dwi_fit(gtab, diffusion_model, image, maskdil, num_threads=mynt)
909    if trim_the_mask > 0 and fit_method is not None:
910        mask = trim_dti_mask(fa, mask, trim_the_mask)
911        tenfit, fa, md1, rgb = efficient_dwi_fit(gtab, diffusion_model, image, maskdil, num_threads=mynt)
912
913    return {
914        "tensormodel": tenfit,
915        "MD": md1,
916        "FA": fa,
917        "RGB": rgb,
918        "dwi_mask": mask,
919        "bvals": bvals,
920        "bvecs": bvecs,
921    }

 945def joint_dti_recon(
 946    img_lr: ants.ANTsImage,

 978            return ants.copy_image_info(img, imgout)

 992            raise ValueError("Provided brain mask should be in reference_b0 space")
 993        brainmaske = ants.iMath(brain_mask, "ME", 2)

 995    reg_rl = (
 996        dti_reg(

1002            type_of_transform=motion_correct,

1006        if img_rl is not None
1007        else None
1008    )
1009
1010    reg_lr = dti_reg(
1011        img_lr,
1012        avg_b0=reference_b0,

1014        bvals=bval_lr,
1015        bvecs=bvec_lr,
1016        type_of_transform=motion_correct,

1020
1021    reg_its = [100, 50, 10]

1080    df_md_wide = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format({"df_MD_JHU_ORRL": df_md_jhu}, col_names=["Mean"])

1082    temp = segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(img_lrdwp)

1084    non_b0_idx = temp["lowermeans"]
1085
1086    fgmask = ants.threshold_image(recon_fa, 0.5, 1.0).iMath("GetLargestComponent")

1089    fa_evr = antspyt1w.patch_eigenvalue_ratio(recon_fa, 512, [16, 16, 16], evdepth=0.9, mask=recon_lr_dewarp["dwi_mask"])
1090    dti_itself = get_dti(recon_fa, recon_lr_dewarp["tensormodel"], return_image=True)
1091
1092    return convert_np_in_dict({
1093        "dti": dti_itself,
1094        "recon_fa": recon_fa,
1095        "recon_fa_summary": df_fa_wide,
1096        "recon_md": recon_md,
1097        "recon_md_summary": df_md_wide,
1098        "jhu_labels": or_fa_jhulabels,

def dwi_deterministic_tracking( dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fa: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bvals: Any, bvecs: Any, num_processes: int = 1, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, label_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, seed_labels: list[int] | None = None, fa_thresh: float = 0.05, seed_density: int = 1, step_size: float = 0.15, peak_indices: Any = None, fit_method: str = 'WLS', verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1124def dwi_deterministic_tracking(
1125    dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
1126    fa: ants.ANTsImage,
1127    bvals: Any,
1128    bvecs: Any,
1129    num_processes: int = 1,
1130    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
1131    label_image: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
1132    seed_labels: list[int] | None = None,
1133    fa_thresh: float = 0.05,
1134    seed_density: int = 1,
1135    step_size: float = 0.15,
1136    peak_indices: Any = None,
1137    fit_method: str = "WLS",
1138    verbose: bool = False,
1139) -> dict[str, Any]:
1140    """Deterministic tractography using DiPy."""
1141    from dipy.data import get_sphere
1142    from dipy.direction import peaks_from_model
1143    from dipy.tracking import utils
1144    from dipy.tracking.local_tracking import LocalTracking
1145    from dipy.tracking.stopping_criterion import ThresholdStoppingCriterion
1146    from dipy.tracking.streamline import Streamlines
1147
1148    affine = ants_to_nibabel_affine(dwi)
1149    if isinstance(bvals, str) or isinstance(bvecs, str):
1150        bvals, bvecs = read_bvals_bvecs(bvals, bvecs)
1151    bvecs = repair_bvecs(bvecs)
1152    gtab = gradient_table(bvals, bvecs=bvecs, atol=2.0)
1153
1154    if mask is None:
1155        mask = ants.threshold_image(fa, fa_thresh, 2.0).iMath("GetLargestComponent")
1156    dwi_data = dwi.numpy()
1157    dwi_mask = mask.numpy() == 1
1158    dti_model = dti.TensorModel(gtab, fit_method=fit_method)
1159
1160    if peak_indices is None:
1161        sphere = get_sphere(name="symmetric362")
1162        peak_indices = peaks_from_model(
1163            model=dti_model,
1164            data=dwi_data,
1165            sphere=sphere,
1166            relative_peak_threshold=0.5,
1167            min_separation_angle=25,
1168            mask=dwi_mask,
1169            npeaks=3,
1170            return_odf=False,
1171            return_sh=False,
1172            parallel=num_processes > 1,
1173            num_processes=num_processes,
1174        )
1175
1176    stopping_criterion = ThresholdStoppingCriterion(fa.numpy(), fa_thresh)
1177    if label_image is None or seed_labels is None:
1178        seed_mask = (fa.numpy() >= fa_thresh).astype(float)
1179    else:
1180        labels = label_image.numpy()
1181        seed_mask = np.isin(labels, seed_labels).astype(float)
1182
1183    seeds = utils.seeds_from_mask(seed_mask, affine=affine, density=seed_density)
1184    generator = LocalTracking(peak_indices, stopping_criterion, seeds, affine=affine, step_size=step_size)
1185    streamlines = Streamlines(generator)
1186
1187    return {
1188        "tractogram": None,
1189        "streamlines": streamlines,
1190        "peak_indices": peak_indices,
1191    }

Deterministic tractography using DiPy.

def dwi_closest_peak_tracking( dwi: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fa: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, bvals: Any, bvecs: Any, num_processes: int = 1, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, label_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, seed_labels: list[int] | None = None, fa_thresh: float = 0.05, seed_density: int = 1, step_size: float = 0.15, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1194def dwi_closest_peak_tracking(
1195    dwi: ants.ANTsImage,
1196    fa: ants.ANTsImage,
1197    bvals: Any,
1198    bvecs: Any,
1199    num_processes: int = 1,
1200    mask: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
1201    label_image: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
1202    seed_labels: list[int] | None = None,
1203    fa_thresh: float = 0.05,
1204    seed_density: int = 1,
1205    step_size: float = 0.15,
1206    verbose: bool = False,
1207) -> dict[str, Any]:
1208    """Closest peak tractography using CSD."""
1209    from dipy.data import small_sphere
1210    from dipy.direction import ClosestPeakDirectionGetter
1211    from dipy.reconst.csdeconv import ConstrainedSphericalDeconvModel, auto_response_ssst
1212    from dipy.reconst.shm import CsaOdfModel
1213    from dipy.tracking import utils
1214    from dipy.tracking.local_tracking import LocalTracking
1215    from dipy.tracking.stopping_criterion import ThresholdStoppingCriterion
1216    from dipy.tracking.streamline import Streamlines
1217
1218    affine = ants_to_nibabel_affine(dwi)
1219    if isinstance(bvals, str) or isinstance(bvecs, str):
1220        bvals, bvecs = read_bvals_bvecs(bvals, bvecs)
1221    bvecs = repair_bvecs(bvecs)
1222    gtab = gradient_table(bvals, bvecs=bvecs, atol=2.0)
1223
1224    if mask is None:
1225        mask = ants.threshold_image(fa, fa_thresh, 2.0).iMath("GetLargestComponent")
1226    dwi_data = dwi.numpy()
1227    dwi_mask = mask.numpy() == 1
1228
1229    response, _ = auto_response_ssst(gtab, dwi_data, roi_radii=10, fa_thr=0.7)
1230    csd_model = ConstrainedSphericalDeconvModel(gtab, response, sh_order=6)
1231    csd_fit = csd_model.fit(dwi_data, mask=dwi_mask)
1232    csa_model = CsaOdfModel(gtab, sh_order=6)
1233    gfa = csa_model.fit(dwi_data, mask=dwi_mask).gfa
1234    stopping_criterion = ThresholdStoppingCriterion(gfa, 0.25)
1235
1236    if label_image is None or seed_labels is None:
1237        seed_mask = (fa.numpy() >= fa_thresh).astype(float)
1238    else:
1239        labels = label_image.numpy()
1240        seed_mask = np.isin(labels, seed_labels).astype(float)
1241
1242    seeds = utils.seeds_from_mask(seed_mask, affine=affine, density=seed_density)
1243    pmf = csd_fit.odf(small_sphere).clip(min=0)
1244    peak_dg = ClosestPeakDirectionGetter.from_pmf(pmf, max_angle=30.0, sphere=small_sphere)
1245    generator = LocalTracking(peak_dg, stopping_criterion, seeds, affine, step_size=step_size)
1246    streamlines = Streamlines(generator)
1247
1248    return {
1249        "tractogram": None,
1250        "streamlines": streamlines,
1251    }

Closest peak tractography using CSD.

def dwi_streamline_pairwise_connectivity( streamlines: Any, label_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, labels_to_connect: list[int | None] | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1254def dwi_streamline_pairwise_connectivity(
1255    streamlines: Any,
1256    label_image: ants.ANTsImage,
1257    labels_to_connect: list[int | None] | None = None,
1258    verbose: bool = False,
1259) -> dict[str, Any]:
1260    """Return streamlines connecting all regions in the label set (ideal for 2 regions)."""
1261    from dipy.tracking import utils
1262    from dipy.tracking.streamline import Streamlines
1263
1264    if labels_to_connect is None:
1265        labels_to_connect = [1, None]
1266    keep_streamlines = Streamlines()
1267    affine = ants_to_nibabel_affine(label_image)
1268    lin_t, offset = utils._mapping_to_voxel(affine)
1269    label_image_np = label_image.numpy()
1270
1271    def check_it(sl: np.ndarray) -> tuple[bool, int]:
1272        for idx in range(sl.shape[0]):
1273            pt = utils._to_voxel_coordinates(sl[idx, :], lin_t, offset)
1274            mylab = int(label_image_np[pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]])
1275            if mylab == labels_to_connect[0] or mylab == labels_to_connect[1]:
1276                return True, mylab
1277        return False, 0
1278
1279    ct = 0
1280    for k in range(len(streamlines)):
1281        sl = streamlines[k]
1282        ok, mylab = check_it(sl)
1283        if ok:
1284            otherind = 0 if mylab == labels_to_connect[1] else 1
1285            lsl = len(sl) - 1
1286            pt = utils._to_voxel_coordinates(sl[lsl, :], lin_t, offset)
1287            mylab_end = int(label_image_np[pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]])
1288            accept_point = mylab_end != 0 if labels_to_connect[1] is None else mylab_end == labels_to_connect[otherind]
1289            if accept_point:
1290                keep_streamlines.append(sl)
1291                ct += 1
1292
1293    return {"streamlines": keep_streamlines, "count": ct}

Return streamlines connecting all regions in the label set (ideal for 2 regions).

def dwi_streamline_connectivity( streamlines: Any, label_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, label_dataframe: pandas.DataFrame, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1296def dwi_streamline_connectivity(
1297    streamlines: Any,
1298    label_image: ants.ANTsImage,
1299    label_dataframe: pd.DataFrame,
1300    verbose: bool = False,
1301) -> dict[str, Any]:
1302    """Summarize network connectivity of streamlines between all regions."""
1303    import antspyt1w
1304    from dipy.tracking import utils
1305
1306    affine = ants_to_nibabel_affine(label_image)
1307    ulabs = label_dataframe["Label"]
1308    labels_to_connect = set(ulabs[ulabs > 0])
1309    lin_t, offset = utils._mapping_to_voxel(affine)
1310    label_image_np = label_image.numpy()
1311
1312    def check_it(sl: np.ndarray, index: int, not_label: int | None = None) -> tuple[bool, int]:
1313        pt = utils._to_voxel_coordinates(sl[index, :], lin_t, offset)
1314        mylab = int(label_image_np[pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]])
1315        if not_label is None:
1316            if mylab in labels_to_connect:
1317                return True, mylab
1318        else:
1319            if mylab in labels_to_connect and mylab != not_label:
1320                return True, mylab
1321        return False, 0
1322
1323    my_count = np.zeros([len(ulabs), len(ulabs)])
1324    for k in range(len(streamlines)):
1325        sl = streamlines[k]
1326        ok1, lab1 = check_it(sl, 0)
1327        if ok1:
1328            ok2, lab2 = check_it(sl, len(sl) - 1, not_label=lab1)
1329            if ok2:
1330                my_count[ulabs == lab1, ulabs == lab2] += 1
1331
1332    ctdf = label_dataframe.copy()
1333    for k in range(len(ulabs)):
1334        nn3 = f"CnxCount{str(k).zfill(3)}"
1335        ctdf.insert(ctdf.shape[1], nn3, my_count[k, :])
1336    ctdfw = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format(
1337        {"networkc": ctdf}, ctdf.keys()[2 : ctdf.shape[1]]
1338    )
1339    return {"connectivity_matrix": my_count, "connectivity_wide": ctdfw}

Summarize network connectivity of streamlines between all regions.

def spec_taper(x: numpy.ndarray, p: float | numpy.ndarray = 0.1) -> numpy.ndarray: 
31def spec_taper(x: np.ndarray, p: float | np.ndarray = 0.1) -> np.ndarray:
32    """Computes a tapered version of x with tapering p."""
33    p_arr = np.r_[p]
34    assert np.all((p_arr >= 0) & (p_arr < 0.5)), "'p' must be between 0 and 0.5"
35    x_arr = np.r_[x].astype("float64")
36    original_shape = x_arr.shape
37    while len(x_arr.shape) < 2:
38        x_arr = np.expand_dims(x_arr, axis=1)
39
40    nr, nc = x_arr.shape
41    p_vec = p_arr * np.ones(nc) if len(p_arr) == 1 else p_arr
42
43    for i in range(nc):
44        m = int(np.floor(nr * p_vec[i]))
45        if m == 0:
46            continue
47        w = 0.5 * (1 - np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(1, 2 * m, step=2) / (2 * m)))
48        x_arr[:, i] = np.r_[w, np.ones(nr - 2 * m), w[::-1]] * x_arr[:, i]
49
50    return np.reshape(x_arr, original_shape)

Computes a tapered version of x with tapering p.

def spec_ci(df: float, coverage: float = 0.95) -> numpy.ndarray: 
53def spec_ci(df: float, coverage: float = 0.95) -> np.ndarray:
54    """Computes confidence interval for a spectral fit."""
55    tail = 1.0 - coverage
56    phi = stats.chi2.cdf(x=df, df=df)
57    upper_quantile = 1.0 - tail * (1.0 - phi)
58    lower_quantile = tail * phi
59    return df / stats.chi2.ppf([upper_quantile, lower_quantile], df=df)

Computes confidence interval for a spectral fit.

def plot_spec( spec_res: dict[str, typing.Any], coverage: float | None = None, ax: Any = None, title: str | None = None) -> None: 
62def plot_spec(spec_res: dict[str, Any], coverage: float | None = None, ax: Any = None, title: str | None = None) -> None:
63    """Plotting method for periodogram results."""
64    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
65
66    f, pxx = spec_res["freq"], spec_res["spec"]
67    if ax is None:
68        ax = plt.gca()
69    ax.plot(f, pxx, color="C0")
70    ax.set_xlabel("Frequency")
71    ax.set_ylabel("Log Spectrum")
72    ax.set_yscale("log")
73    ax.set_title(spec_res["method"] if title is None else title)

Plotting method for periodogram results.

def spec_pgram( x: numpy.ndarray, xfreq: float = 1.0, spans: Any = None, kernel: Any = None, taper: float = 0.1, pad: int = 0, fast: bool = True, demean: bool = False, detrend: bool = True, plot: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
 76def spec_pgram(
 77    x: np.ndarray,
 78    xfreq: float = 1.0,
 79    spans: Any = None,
 80    kernel: Any = None,
 81    taper: float = 0.1,
 82    pad: int = 0,
 83    fast: bool = True,
 84    demean: bool = False,
 85    detrend: bool = True,
 86    plot: bool = False,
 87    **kwargs: Any,
 88) -> dict[str, Any]:
 89    """Computes the spectral density estimate using a periodogram."""
 90    def daniell_window_modified(m: int) -> np.ndarray:
 91        def w(k: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 92            return np.where(np.abs(k) < m, 1 / (2 * m), np.where(np.abs(k) == m, 1 / (4 * m), 0))
 93        return w(np.arange(-m, m + 1))
 94
 95    def daniell_window_convolve(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 96        if len(v) == 0:
 97            return np.r_[1]
 98        if len(v) == 1:
 99            return daniell_window_modified(v[0])
100        return signal.convolve(daniell_window_modified(v[0]), daniell_window_convolve(v[1:]))
101
102    x_arr = np.r_[x].astype("float64")
103    original_shape = x_arr.shape
104    while len(x_arr.shape) < 2:
105        x_arr = np.expand_dims(x_arr, axis=1)
106
107    n, nser = x_arr.shape
108    n0 = n
109
110    if spans is not None:
111        kernel = daniell_window_convolve(np.floor_divide(np.r_[spans], 2))
112
113    if detrend:
114        t = np.arange(n) - (n - 1) / 2
115        sumt2 = n * (n**2 - 1) / 12
116        x_arr -= np.repeat(np.expand_dims(np.mean(x_arr, axis=0), 0), n, axis=0) + np.outer(np.sum(x_arr.T * t, axis=1), t / sumt2).T
117    elif demean:
118        x_arr -= np.mean(x_arr, axis=0)
119
120    x_arr = spec_taper(x_arr, taper)
121    u2 = 1 - (5 / 8) * taper * 2
122    u4 = 1 - (93 / 128) * taper * 2
123
124    if pad > 0:
125        x_arr = np.r_[x_arr, np.zeros((pad * x_arr.shape[0], x_arr.shape[1]))]
126        n = x_arr.shape[0]
127
128    if fast:
129        new_n = fft.next_fast_len(n, True)
130        x_arr = np.r_[x_arr, np.zeros((new_n - n, x_arr.shape[1]))]
131        n = new_n
132
133    nspec = int(np.floor(n / 2))
134    freq = (np.arange(nspec) + 1) * xfreq / n
135    xfft = fft.fft(x_arr.T).T
136
137    pgram = np.empty((n, nser, nser), dtype="complex")
138    for i in range(nser):
139        for j in range(nser):
140            pgram[:, i, j] = xfft[:, i] * np.conj(xfft[:, j]) / (n0 * xfreq)
141            pgram[0, i, j] = 0.5 * (pgram[1, i, j] + pgram[-1, i, j])
142
143    if kernel is None:
144        df = 2.0
145        bandwidth = np.sqrt(1 / 12)
146    else:
147        def conv_circular(sig: np.ndarray, kern: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
148            pad_len = len(sig) - len(kern)
149            half_window = int((len(kern) + 1) / 2)
150            indices = range(-half_window, len(sig) - half_window)
151            orig_conv = np.real(fft.ifft(fft.fft(sig) * fft.fft(np.r_[np.zeros(pad_len), kern])))
152            return orig_conv.take(indices, mode="wrap")
153
154        for i in range(nser):
155            for j in range(nser):
156                pgram[:, i, j] = conv_circular(pgram[:, i, j], kernel)
157
158        df = 2 / np.sum(kernel**2)
159        m = (len(kernel) - 1) / 2
160        k = np.arange(-m, m + 1)
161        bandwidth = np.sqrt(np.sum((1 / 12 + k**2) * kernel))
162
163    df = df / (u4 / u2**2) * (n0 / n)
164    bandwidth = bandwidth * xfreq / n
165    pgram = pgram[1 : (nspec + 1), :, :]
166
167    spec = np.empty((nspec, nser))
168    for i in range(nser):
169        spec[:, i] = np.real(pgram[:, i, i])
170
171    spec = (spec / u2).squeeze()
172    return {
173        "freq": freq,
174        "spec": spec,
175        "kernel": kernel,
176        "df": df,
177        "bandwidth": bandwidth,
178        "method": "Raw Periodogram" if kernel is None else "Smoothed Periodogram",
179    }

Computes the spectral density estimate using a periodogram.

def alffmap( x: numpy.ndarray, flo: float = 0.01, fhi: float = 0.1, tr: float = 1.0, detrend: bool = True) -> dict[str, float]: 
182def alffmap(x: np.ndarray, flo: float = 0.01, fhi: float = 0.1, tr: float = 1.0, detrend: bool = True) -> dict[str, float]:
183    """Amplitude of Low Frequency Fluctuations (ALFF and f/ALFF)."""
184    temp = spec_pgram(x, xfreq=1.0 / tr, demean=False, detrend=detrend, taper=0, fast=True, plot=False)
185    fselect = np.logical_and(temp["freq"] >= flo, temp["freq"] <= fhi)
186    denom = float(temp["spec"].sum())
187    numer = float(temp["spec"][fselect].sum())
188    falff = numer / denom if denom > 0 else 0.0
189    return {"alff": numer, "falff": falff}

Amplitude of Low Frequency Fluctuations (ALFF and f/ALFF).

def alff_image( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, flo: float = 0.01, fhi: float = 0.1, nuisance: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> dict[str, ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage]: 
197def alff_image(
198    x: ants.ANTsImage,
199    mask: ants.ANTsImage,
200    flo: float = 0.01,
201    fhi: float = 0.1,
202    nuisance: np.ndarray | None = None,
203) -> dict[str, ants.ANTsImage]:
204    """Compute ALFF and fALFF images over mask."""
205    xmat = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(x, mask)
206    if nuisance is not None:
207        xmat = ants.regress_components(xmat, nuisance)
208    alffvec = np.zeros(xmat.shape[1])
209    falffvec = np.zeros(xmat.shape[1])
210    mytr = float(ants.get_spacing(x)[3])
211    for n in range(xmat.shape[1]):
212        temp = alffmap(xmat[:, n], flo=flo, fhi=fhi, tr=mytr)
213        alffvec[n] = temp["alff"]
214        falffvec[n] = temp["falff"]
215    alffi = ants.make_image(mask, alffvec)
216    falffi = ants.make_image(mask, falffvec)
217    alff_tm = calculate_trimmed_mean(alffvec, 0.01)
218    falff_tm = calculate_trimmed_mean(falffvec, 0.01)
219    if alff_tm > 0:
220        alffi = alffi / alff_tm
221    if falff_tm > 0:
222        falffi = falffi / falff_tm
223    return {"alff": alffi, "falff": falffi}

Compute ALFF and fALFF images over mask.

def compute_PerAF_voxel(time_series: numpy.ndarray) -> float: 
226def compute_PerAF_voxel(time_series: np.ndarray) -> float:
227    """Compute Percentage Amplitude Fluctuation (PerAF) for a 1D time series."""
228    n = len(time_series)
229    m = np.mean(time_series)
230    if m == 0:
231        return 0.0
232    return float((100.0 / n) * np.sum(np.abs((time_series - m) / m)))

Compute Percentage Amplitude Fluctuation (PerAF) for a 1D time series.

def calculate_trimmed_mean(data: numpy.ndarray, proportion_to_trim: float = 0.01) -> float: 
192def calculate_trimmed_mean(data: np.ndarray, proportion_to_trim: float = 0.01) -> float:
193    """Calculate trimmed mean."""
194    return float(stats.trim_mean(data, proportion_to_trim))

Calculate trimmed mean.

def PerAF( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, globalmean: bool = True) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
235def PerAF(x: ants.ANTsImage, mask: ants.ANTsImage, globalmean: bool = True) -> ants.ANTsImage:
236    """Compute Percentage Amplitude Fluctuation (PerAF) image."""
237    time_series = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(x, mask)
238    n = time_series.shape[1]
239    vec = np.zeros(n)
240    for i in range(n):
241        vec[i] = compute_PerAF_voxel(time_series[:, i])
242    outimg = ants.make_image(mask, vec)
243    if globalmean:
244        tm = calculate_trimmed_mean(vec, 0.01)
245        if tm > 0:
246            outimg = outimg / tm
247    return outimg

Compute Percentage Amplitude Fluctuation (PerAF) image.

def despike_time_series_afni( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, c1: float = 2.5, c2: float = 4.0) -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray]: 
250def despike_time_series_afni(image: ants.ANTsImage, c1: float = 2.5, c2: float = 4.0) -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray]:
251    """Despike a time series image using polynomial fitting and AFNI-style squashing."""
252    data = image.numpy()
253    despiked_data = np.copy(data)
254    curve = np.zeros_like(despiked_data)
255
256    def l1_fit_polynomial(ts: np.ndarray, degree: int = 2) -> np.ndarray:
257        t = np.arange(len(ts))
258        coefs = np.polyfit(t, ts, degree)
259        return np.polyval(coefs, t)
260
261    for x_idx in range(data.shape[0]):
262        for y_idx in range(data.shape[1]):
263            for z_idx in range(data.shape[2]):
264                curve[x_idx, y_idx, z_idx, :] = l1_fit_polynomial(data[x_idx, y_idx, z_idx, :], degree=2)
265
266    residuals = data - curve
267    mad = np.median(np.abs(residuals - np.median(residuals, axis=-1, keepdims=True)), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
268    sigma = np.sqrt(np.pi / 2.0) * mad
269    sigma_safe = np.where(sigma == 0, 1e-10, sigma)
270
271    spike_counts = np.zeros(image.shape[3])
272    for i in range(data.shape[-1]):
273        s = (data[..., i] - curve[..., i]) / sigma_safe[..., 0]
274        ww = s > c1
275        s_prime = np.where(ww, c1 + (c2 - c1) * np.tanh((s - c1) / (c2 - c1)), s)
276        spike_counts[i] = ww.sum()
277        despiked_data[..., i] = curve[..., i] + s_prime * sigma[..., 0]
278
279    despiked_image = ants.from_numpy(despiked_data)
280    return ants.copy_image_info(image, despiked_image), spike_counts

Despike a time series image using polynomial fitting and AFNI-style squashing.

def despike_time_series( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, threshold: float = 3.0, replacement: str = 'threshold') -> tuple[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, numpy.ndarray]: 
283def despike_time_series(image: ants.ANTsImage, threshold: float = 3.0, replacement: str = "threshold") -> tuple[ants.ANTsImage, np.ndarray]:
284    """Despike a time series image by z-score thresholding."""
285    data = image.numpy()
286    mean = np.mean(data, axis=-1)
287    std = np.std(data, axis=-1)
288    spikes = np.abs(data - mean[..., np.newaxis]) > threshold * std[..., np.newaxis]
289    spike_counts = np.zeros(image.shape[3])
290
291    for i in range(data.shape[-1]):
292        sl = data[..., i]
293        locs = spikes[..., i]
294        spike_counts[i] = locs.sum()
295        if replacement == "median":
296            sl[locs] = np.median(sl)
297        else:
298            thresh_vals = mean + np.sign(sl - mean) * threshold * std
299            sl[locs] = thresh_vals[locs]
300        data[..., i] = sl
301
302    despike_image = ants.from_numpy(data)
303    return ants.copy_image_info(image, despike_image), spike_counts

Despike a time series image by z-score thresholding.

def copy_spatial_metadata_from_3d_to_4d( spatial_img: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, timeseries_img: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
306def copy_spatial_metadata_from_3d_to_4d(spatial_img: ants.ANTsImage, timeseries_img: ants.ANTsImage) -> ants.ANTsImage:
307    """Copy spatial geometry from 3D reference to 4D timeseries."""
308    new_origin = list(spatial_img.origin) + [list(timeseries_img.origin)[3]]
309    new_spacing = list(spatial_img.spacing) + [list(timeseries_img.spacing)[3]]
310    new_direction = timeseries_img.direction.copy()
311    new_direction[:3, :3] = spatial_img.direction
312    return ants.from_numpy(timeseries_img.numpy(), origin=new_origin, spacing=new_spacing, direction=new_direction)

Copy spatial geometry from 3D reference to 4D timeseries.

def estimate_optimal_pca_components(data: numpy.ndarray, variance_threshold: float = 0.8) -> int: 
462def estimate_optimal_pca_components(data: np.ndarray, variance_threshold: float = 0.80) -> int:
463    """Estimate optimal number of PCA components to represent data."""
464    pca = PCA()
465    pca.fit(data)
466    cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
467    return int(np.where(cumulative_variance >= variance_threshold)[0][0] + 1)

Estimate optimal number of PCA components to represent data.

def resting_state_fmri_networks( fmri: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, fmri_template: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1segmentation: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, f: list[float] | None = None, FD_threshold: float = 5.0, spa: float | None = None, spt: float | None = None, nc: int | float = 5, outlier_threshold: float = 0.25, ica_components: int = 0, impute: bool = True, censor: bool = True, despike: float = 2.5, motion_as_nuisance: bool = True, powers: bool = False, upsample: float = 3.0, clean_tmp: float | None = None, paramset: str = 'unset', verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]:

492    """Compute resting state network correlation maps based on Power or Yeo 2023 nodes."""
