756    if not powers:
757        if "DefaultA" in outdict and "DefaultB" in outdict and "DefaultC" in outdict:
758            outdict["DefaultMode"] = outdict["DefaultA"] + outdict["DefaultB"] + outdict["DefaultC"]
759        if "VisCent" in outdict and "VisPeri" in outdict:
760            outdict["Visual"] = outdict["VisCent"] + outdict["VisPeri"]
761
762    outdict["motion_corrected"] = corrmo["motion_corrected"]
763    outdict["nuisance"] = pd.DataFrame(nuisance)
764    outdict["PerAF"] = perafimg
765    outdict["tsnr"] = mytsnr
766    outdict["ssnr"] = slice_snr(corrmo["motion_corrected"], csf_and_wm, gmseg)
767    outdict["dvars"] = dvars(corrmo["motion_corrected"], gmseg)
768    outdict["bandpass_freq_0"] = f[0]
769    outdict["bandpass_freq_1"] = f[1]
770    outdict["censor"] = int(censor)
771    outdict["spatial_smoothing"] = spa
772    outdict["outlier_threshold"] = outlier_threshold
773    outdict["FD_threshold"] = FD_threshold
774    outdict["high_motion_count"] = high_motion_count
775    outdict["high_motion_pct"] = high_motion_pct
776    outdict["despiking_count_summary"] = despiking_count_summary
777    outdict["FD_max"] = float(corrmo["FD"].max())
778    outdict["FD_mean"] = float(corrmo["FD"].mean())
779    outdict["FD_sd"] = float(corrmo["FD"].std())
780    outdict["bold_evr"] = antspyt1w.patch_eigenvalue_ratio(und, 512, [16, 16, 16], evdepth=0.9, mask=bmask)
781    outdict["n_outliers"] = len(hlinds)
782    outdict["nc_wm"] = int(nc_wm)
783    outdict["nc_csf"] = int(nc_csf)
784    outdict["minutes_original_data"] = float((tr * fmri.shape[3]) / 60.0)
785    outdict["minutes_censored_data"] = float((tr * simg.shape[3]) / 60.0)
786    return convert_np_in_dict(outdict)

Compute resting state network correlation maps based on Power or Yeo 2023 nodes.

def neuromelanin( list_nm_images: list[ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage], t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1_head: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1lab: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, brain_stem_dilation: int = 8, bias_correct: bool = True, denoise: int | None = None, srmodel: Any = None, target_range: list[float] | None = None, poly_order: str | int | None = 'hist', normalize_nm: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
 86def neuromelanin(
 87    list_nm_images: list[ants.ANTsImage],
 88    t1: ants.ANTsImage,
 89    t1_head: ants.ANTsImage,
 90    t1lab: ants.ANTsImage,
 91    brain_stem_dilation: int = 8,
 92    bias_correct: bool = True,
 93    denoise: int | None = None,
 94    srmodel: Any = None,
 95    target_range: list[float] | None = None,
 96    poly_order: str | int | None = "hist",
 97    normalize_nm: bool = False,
 98    verbose: bool = False,
 99) -> dict[str, Any]:
100    """Averaged and registered neuromelanin quantification."""
101    import antspynet
102    import antspyt1w
103
104    if target_range is None:
105        target_range = [0, 1]
106
107    fnt = os.path.expanduser("~/.antspyt1w/CIT168_T1w_700um_pad_adni.nii.gz")
108    fnt_nm = os.path.expanduser("~/.antspymm/CIT168_T1w_700um_pad_adni_NM_norm_avg.nii.gz")
109    fnt_bst = os.path.expanduser("~/.antspyt1w/CIT168_T1w_700um_pad_adni_brainstem.nii.gz")
110    fn_slab = os.path.expanduser("~/.antspyt1w/CIT168_MT_Slab_adni.nii.gz")
111
112    template = ants.image_read(fnt, reorient=False)
113    template_nm = ants.iMath(ants.image_read(fnt_nm, reorient=False), "Normalize")
114    template_bstem = ants.image_read(fnt_bst, reorient=False).threshold_image(1, 1000)
115
116    reg = ants.registration(t1, template, "antsRegistrationSyNQuickRepro[s]")
117    nmavg2t1 = ants.apply_transforms(t1, template_nm, reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="linear")
118    slab2t1 = ants.threshold_image(nmavg2t1, "Otsu", 2).threshold_image(1, 2).iMath("MD", 1).iMath("FillHoles")
119    bstem2t1 = ants.apply_transforms(t1, template_bstem, reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor").iMath("MD", 1)
120    bstem2t1 = ants.crop_image(bstem2t1, slab2t1)
121    cropper = ants.decrop_image(bstem2t1, slab2t1).iMath("MD", brain_stem_dilation)
122
123    nm_imgs = list(list_nm_images)
124    nm_avg = nm_imgs[0] * 0.0
125    for k in range(len(nm_imgs)):
126        if denoise is not None:
127            nm_imgs[k] = ants.denoise_image(nm_imgs[k], shrink_factor=1, p=denoise, r=denoise + 1, noise_model="Gaussian")
128        if bias_correct:
129            n4mask = ants.threshold_image(ants.iMath(nm_imgs[k], "Normalize"), 0.05, 1)
130            nm_imgs[k] = ants.n4_bias_field_correction(nm_imgs[k], mask=n4mask)
131        nm_avg = nm_avg + ants.resample_image_to_target(nm_imgs[k], nm_avg) / len(nm_imgs)
132
133    nm_avg_new = nm_avg * 0.0
134    txlist: list[str] = []
135    for k in range(len(nm_imgs)):
136        current_image = ants.registration(nm_imgs[k], nm_avg, type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")
137        txlist.append(current_image["fwdtransforms"][0])
138        nm_avg_new = nm_avg_new + current_image["warpedfixout"] / len(nm_imgs)
139    nm_avg = nm_avg_new
140
141    t1c = ants.crop_image(t1_head, slab2t1).iMath("Normalize")
142    slabreg = tra_initializer(nm_avg, t1c, verbose=verbose)
143    labels2nm = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg, t1lab, slabreg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="genericLabel")
144    cropper2nm = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg, cropper, slabreg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor")
145
146    crop_nm_list: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
147    for k in range(len(nm_imgs)):
148        concattx = [txlist[k], slabreg["fwdtransforms"][0]]
149        cropmask = ants.apply_transforms(nm_imgs[k], cropper, concattx, interpolator="nearestNeighbor")
150        crop_nm_list.append(ants.crop_image(nm_imgs[k], cropmask))
151
152    if srmodel is not None:
153        for k in range(len(crop_nm_list)):
154            temp = antspynet.apply_super_resolution_model_to_image(crop_nm_list[k], srmodel, target_range=target_range)
155            if poly_order is not None:
156                bilin = ants.resample_image_to_target(crop_nm_list[k], temp)
157                temp = (
158                    ants.histogram_match_image(temp, bilin)
159                    if poly_order == "hist"
160                    else antspynet.regression_match_image(temp, bilin, poly_order=poly_order)
161                )
162            crop_nm_list[k] = temp
163
164    nm_avg_cropped = crop_nm_list[0] * 0.0
165    for k in range(len(crop_nm_list)):
166        nm_avg_cropped = nm_avg_cropped + ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg_cropped, crop_nm_list[k], txlist[k]) / len(crop_nm_list)
167
168    for _ in range(3):
169        nm_avg_cropped_new = nm_avg_cropped * 0.0
170        for k in range(len(crop_nm_list)):
171            myreg = ants.registration(
172                ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "Normalize"), ants.iMath(crop_nm_list[k], "Normalize"), "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]"
173            )
174            warpednext = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg_cropped_new, crop_nm_list[k], myreg["fwdtransforms"])
175            nm_avg_cropped_new = nm_avg_cropped_new + warpednext
176        nm_avg_cropped = nm_avg_cropped_new / len(crop_nm_list)
177
178    slabreg_updated = tra_initializer(nm_avg_cropped, t1c, compreg=slabreg, verbose=verbose)
179    temp_orig = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg_cropped, t1c, slabreg["fwdtransforms"])
180    temp_update = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg_cropped, t1c, slabreg_updated["fwdtransforms"])
181    mi_update = float(ants.image_mutual_information(ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "Normalize"), ants.iMath(temp_update, "Normalize")))
182    mi_orig = float(ants.image_mutual_information(ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "Normalize"), ants.iMath(temp_orig, "Normalize")))
183    if mi_update < mi_orig:
184        slabreg = slabreg_updated
185
186    if normalize_nm:
187        nm_avg_cropped = ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "Normalize")
188        nm_avg_cropped = ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "TruncateIntensity", 0.05, 0.95)
189        nm_avg_cropped = ants.iMath(nm_avg_cropped, "Normalize")
190
191    labels2nm = ants.apply_transforms(nm_avg_cropped, t1lab, slabreg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor")
192
193    def get_biggest_part(x: ants.ANTsImage, labeln: int) -> None:
194        temp_comp = ants.threshold_image(x, labeln, labeln).iMath("GetLargestComponent")
195        x[x == labeln] = 0
196        x[temp_comp == 1] = labeln
197
198    get_biggest_part(labels2nm, 33)
199    get_biggest_part(labels2nm, 34)
200
201    nmdf = antspyt1w.map_intensity_to_dataframe("CIT168_Reinf_Learn_v1_label_descriptions_pad", nm_avg_cropped, labels2nm)
202    nmdf_wide = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format({"NM": nmdf}, col_names=["Mean"])
203
204    rr_mask = ants.mask_image(labels2nm, labels2nm, [33, 34], binarize=True)
205    sn_mask = ants.mask_image(labels2nm, labels2nm, [7, 9, 23, 25], binarize=True)
206    nmavgsnr = mask_snr(nm_avg_cropped, rr_mask, sn_mask, bias_correct=False)
207
208    snavg = float(nm_avg_cropped[sn_mask == 1].mean())
209    rravg = float(nm_avg_cropped[rr_mask == 1].mean())
210    snstd = float(nm_avg_cropped[sn_mask == 1].std())
211    rrstd = float(nm_avg_cropped[rr_mask == 1].std())
212    vol_element = float(np.prod(ants.get_spacing(sn_mask)))
213    snvol = float(vol_element * sn_mask.sum())
214
215    if snvol > 0:
216        sn_z = float(ants.transform_physical_point_to_index(sn_mask, ants.get_center_of_mass(sn_mask))[2]) / sn_mask.shape[2]
217    else:
218        sn_z = math.nan
219
220    nm_evr = (
221        antspyt1w.patch_eigenvalue_ratio(nm_avg, 512, [6, 6, 6], evdepth=0.9, mask=cropper2nm)
222        if cropper2nm.sum() > 0
223        else 0.0
224    )
225
226    simg = ants.smooth_image(nm_avg_cropped, float(np.min(ants.get_spacing(nm_avg_cropped))))
227    nmabovekthresh_mask = sn_mask * ants.threshold_image(simg, rravg + 2.0 * rrstd, math.inf)
228    snvolabovethresh = float(vol_element * nmabovekthresh_mask.sum())
229    snintmeanabovethresh = float((simg * nmabovekthresh_mask).mean())
230    snintsumabovethresh = float((simg * nmabovekthresh_mask).sum())
231
232    nmabovekthresh_mask3 = sn_mask * ants.threshold_image(simg, rravg + 3.0 * rrstd, math.inf)
233    snvolabovethresh3 = float(vol_element * nmabovekthresh_mask3.sum())
234
235    nmabovekthresh_mask1 = sn_mask * ants.threshold_image(simg, rravg + 1.0 * rrstd, math.inf)
236    snvolabovethresh1 = float(vol_element * nmabovekthresh_mask1.sum())
237
238    return convert_np_in_dict({
239        "NM_avg": nm_avg,
240        "NM_avg_cropped": nm_avg_cropped,
241        "NM_labels": labels2nm,
242        "NM_cropped": crop_nm_list,
243        "NM_midbrainROI": cropper2nm,
244        "NM_dataframe": nmdf,
245        "NM_dataframe_wide": nmdf_wide,
246        "t1_to_NM": slabreg["warpedmovout"],
247        "t1_to_NM_transform": slabreg["fwdtransforms"],
248        "NM_avg_signaltonoise": nmavgsnr,
249        "NM_avg_substantianigra": snavg,
250        "NM_std_substantianigra": snstd,
251        "NM_volume_substantianigra": snvol,
252        "NM_volume_substantianigra_1std": snvolabovethresh1,
253        "NM_volume_substantianigra_2std": snvolabovethresh,
254        "NM_intmean_substantianigra_2std": snintmeanabovethresh,
255        "NM_intsum_substantianigra_2std": snintsumabovethresh,
256        "NM_volume_substantianigra_3std": snvolabovethresh3,
257        "NM_avg_refregion": rravg,
258        "NM_std_refregion": rrstd,
259        "NM_min": float(nm_avg_cropped.min()),
260        "NM_max": float(nm_avg_cropped.max()),
261        "NM_mean": float(nm_avg_cropped.numpy().mean()),
262        "NM_sd": float(np.std(nm_avg_cropped.numpy())),
263        "NM_q0pt05": float(np.quantile(nm_avg_cropped.numpy(), 0.05)),
264        "NM_q0pt10": float(np.quantile(nm_avg_cropped.numpy(), 0.10)),
265        "NM_q0pt90": float(np.quantile(nm_avg_cropped.numpy(), 0.90)),
266        "NM_q0pt95": float(np.quantile(nm_avg_cropped.numpy(), 0.95)),
267        "NM_substantianigra_z_coordinate": sn_z,
268        "NM_evr": nm_evr,
269        "NM_count": len(list_nm_images),
270    })

Averaged and registered neuromelanin quantification.

def calculate_CBF( Delta_M: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, M_0: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, mask: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, Lambda: float = 0.9, T_1: float = 0.67, Alpha: float = 0.68, w: float = 1.0, Tau: float = 1.5) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
28def calculate_CBF(
29    Delta_M: ants.ANTsImage,
30    M_0: ants.ANTsImage,
31    mask: ants.ANTsImage,
32    Lambda: float = 0.9,
33    T_1: float = 0.67,
34    Alpha: float = 0.68,
35    w: float = 1.0,
36    Tau: float = 1.5,
37) -> ants.ANTsImage:
38    """Calculate Cerebral Blood Flow (CBF) from difference and M0 images using the pCASL model."""
39    cbf = M_0 * 0.0
40    m0_data = M_0.numpy()
41    mask_data = mask.numpy()
42    m0thresh = float(np.quantile(m0_data[mask_data == 1], 0.1))
43    sel = (mask_data == 1) & (m0_data >= m0thresh)
44
45    delta_m_data = Delta_M.numpy()
46    cbf_data = cbf.numpy()
47    denom = m0_data[sel] * 2.0 * Alpha * (np.exp(-w * T_1) - np.exp(-(Tau + w) * T_1))
48    denom = np.where(denom == 0, 1e-10, denom)
49    cbf_data[sel] = delta_m_data[sel] * 60.0 * 100.0 * (Lambda * T_1) / denom
50    cbf_data[cbf_data < 0.0] = 0.0
51
52    cbf_img = ants.from_numpy(cbf_data)
53    return ants.copy_image_info(M_0, cbf_img)

Calculate Cerebral Blood Flow (CBF) from difference and M0 images using the pCASL model.

def bold_perfusion_minimal( fmri: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, m0_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, spa: tuple[float, float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), nc: int = 0, tc: str = 'alternating', n_to_trim: int = 0, outlier_threshold: float = 0.25, plot_brain_mask: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
 82def bold_perfusion_minimal(
 83    fmri: ants.ANTsImage,
 84    m0_image: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
 85    spa: tuple[float, float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
 86    nc: int = 0,
 87    tc: str = "alternating",
 88    n_to_trim: int = 0,
 89    outlier_threshold: float = 0.250,
 90    plot_brain_mask: bool = False,
 91    verbose: bool = False,
 92) -> dict[str, Any]:
 93    """Estimate perfusion minimally from a BOLD time series without T1 image."""
 94    import antspynet
 95
 96    fmri_template = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(fmri)
 97    mytrim = n_to_trim or 0
 98    perf_total_sigma = 1.5
 99    corrmo = timeseries_reg(
100        fmri,
101        fmri_template,
102        type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
103        total_sigma=perf_total_sigma,
104        fdOffset=2.0,
105        trim=mytrim,
106        output_directory=None,
107        verbose=verbose,
108        syn_metric="CC",
109        syn_sampling=2,
110        reg_iterations=[40, 20, 5],
111    )
112
113    ntp = corrmo["motion_corrected"].shape[3]
114    fmri_template = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"])
115    bmask = antspynet.brain_extraction(fmri_template, "bold").threshold_image(0.5, 1).iMath("GetLargestComponent").morphology("close", 2).iMath("FillHoles")
116
117    tclist = _replicate_list(["C", "T"], ntp) if tc == "alternating" else _replicate_list(["C"], int(ntp / 2)) + _replicate_list(["T"], int(ntp / 2))
118    tclist_enc = _one_hot_encode(tclist[:ntp])
119    fmrimotcorr = corrmo["motion_corrected"]
120    hlinds = None
121
122    if 0.0 < outlier_threshold < 1.0:
123        fmrimotcorr, hlinds = loop_timeseries_censoring(fmrimotcorr, outlier_threshold, mask=None, verbose=verbose)
124        tclist_enc = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(tclist_enc, hlinds)
125        corrmo["FD"] = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(corrmo["FD"], hlinds)
126
127    fmri_template = ants.iMath(ants.get_average_of_timeseries(fmrimotcorr), "Normalize")
128    corrmo = timeseries_reg(
129        fmri,
130        fmri_template,
131        type_of_transform="antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
132        total_sigma=perf_total_sigma,
133        fdOffset=2.0,
134        trim=mytrim,
135        output_directory=None,
136        verbose=verbose,
137        syn_metric="CC",
138        syn_sampling=2,
139        reg_iterations=[40, 20, 5],
140    )
141
142    if 0.0 < outlier_threshold < 1.0:
143        corrmo["motion_corrected"] = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"], hlinds)
144        corrmo["FD"] = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(corrmo["FD"], hlinds)
145
146    bmask = antspynet.brain_extraction(fmri_template, "bold").threshold_image(0.5, 1).iMath("GetLargestComponent").morphology("close", 2).iMath("FillHoles")
147    mytsnr = tsnr(corrmo["motion_corrected"], bmask)
148    mytsnr_thresh = float(np.quantile(mytsnr.numpy(), 0.995))
149    tsnrmask = ants.threshold_image(mytsnr, 0, mytsnr_thresh).morphology("close", 3)
150    bmask = bmask * ants.iMath(tsnrmask, "FillHoles")
151
152    fmrimotcorr = corrmo["motion_corrected"]
153    und = fmri_template * bmask
154    mycompcor = ants.compcor(fmrimotcorr, ncompcor=nc, quantile=0.50, mask=bmask, filter_type="polynomial", degree=2)
155    simg = ants.smooth_image(fmrimotcorr, spa, sigma_in_physical_coordinates=True)
156    nuisance = np.c_[mycompcor["basis"], mycompcor["components"]]
157    nuisance = ants.regress_components(nuisance, tclist_enc)
158
159    regression_mask = bmask.clone()
160    gmmat = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(simg, regression_mask)
161    regvars = np.hstack((nuisance, tclist_enc))
162    regvars = regvars[:, : regvars.shape[1] - 1]
163
164    regression_model = LinearRegression()
165    regression_model.fit(regvars, gmmat)
166    coefind = regression_model.coef_.shape[1] - 1
167    perfimg = ants.make_image(regression_mask, regression_model.coef_[:, coefind])
168    gmseg = ants.image_clone(bmask)
169    meangmval = float((perfimg[gmseg == 1]).mean())
170    if meangmval < 0:
171        perfimg = perfimg * -1.0
172    negative_voxels = float((perfimg < 0.0).sum() / np.prod(perfimg.shape) * 100.0)
173    perfimg[perfimg < 0.0] = 0.0
174
175    if m0_image is None:
176        m0 = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(fmrimotcorr)
177    else:
178        m0reg = ants.registration(fmri_template, m0_image, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", verbose=False)
179        m0 = m0reg["warpedmovout"]
180
181    if ntp == 2:
182        img0 = ants.slice_image(corrmo["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=0)
183        img1 = ants.slice_image(corrmo["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=1)
184        if m0_image is None:
185            perfimg, m0 = (img0, img1) if img0.mean() < img1.mean() else (img1, img0)
186        else:
187            perfimg = img1 - img0 if img0.mean() < img1.mean() else img0 - img1
188
189    cbf = calculate_CBF(Delta_M=perfimg, M_0=m0, mask=bmask)
190    meangmval = float((perfimg[gmseg == 1]).mean())
191    meangmvalcbf = float((cbf[gmseg == 1]).mean())
192
193    rsf_nuisance = pd.DataFrame(nuisance)
194    rsf_nuisance["FD"] = corrmo["FD"]
195
196    return convert_np_in_dict({
197        "meanBold": und,
198        "brainmask": bmask,
199        "perfusion": perfimg,
200        "cbf": cbf,
201        "m0": m0,
202        "perfusion_gm_mean": meangmval,
203        "cbf_gm_mean": meangmvalcbf,
204        "motion_corrected": corrmo["motion_corrected"],
205        "brain_mask": bmask,
206        "nuisance": rsf_nuisance,
207        "tsnr": mytsnr,
208        "dvars": dvars(corrmo["motion_corrected"], gmseg),
209        "FD_max": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].max()),
210        "FD_mean": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].mean()),
211        "FD_sd": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].std()),
212        "outlier_volumes": hlinds,
213        "negative_voxels": negative_voxels,
214    })

Estimate perfusion minimally from a BOLD time series without T1 image.

def bold_perfusion( fmri: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1head: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1segmentation: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1dktcit: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, FD_threshold: float = 0.5, spa: tuple[float, float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), nc: int = 3, type_of_transform: str = 'antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]', tc: str = 'alternating', n_to_trim: int = 0, m0_image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage | None = None, m0_indices: list[int] | None = None, outlier_threshold: float = 0.25, add_FD_to_nuisance: bool = False, n3: bool = False, segment_timeseries: bool = False, trim_the_mask: float = 4.25, upsample: bool = True, perfusion_regression_model: str = 'linear', verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
217def bold_perfusion(
218    fmri: ants.ANTsImage,
219    t1head: ants.ANTsImage,
220    t1: ants.ANTsImage,
221    t1segmentation: ants.ANTsImage,
222    t1dktcit: ants.ANTsImage,
223    FD_threshold: float = 0.5,
224    spa: tuple[float, float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
225    nc: int = 3,
226    type_of_transform: str = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
227    tc: str = "alternating",
228    n_to_trim: int = 0,
229    m0_image: ants.ANTsImage | None = None,
230    m0_indices: list[int] | None = None,
231    outlier_threshold: float = 0.250,
232    add_FD_to_nuisance: bool = False,
233    n3: bool = False,
234    segment_timeseries: bool = False,
235    trim_the_mask: float = 4.25,
236    upsample: bool = True,
237    perfusion_regression_model: str = "linear",
238    verbose: bool = False,
239) -> dict[str, Any]:
240    """Estimate perfusion and quantified CBF from a BOLD time series with anatomical guidance."""
241    import antspyt1w
242
243    if segment_timeseries:
244        lo_vs_high = segment_timeseries_by_meanvalue(fmri)
245        fmri = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(fmri, lo_vs_high["lowermeans"])
246
247    if m0_image is not None and m0_image.dimension == 4:
248        m0_image = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(m0_image)
249
250    fmri_temp_raw, _ = loop_timeseries_censoring(fmri, 0.10)
251    fmri_template = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(fmri_temp_raw)
252    rig = ants.registration(fmri_template, t1head, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")
253    bmask = ants.apply_transforms(
254        fmri_template, ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 1, 6), rig["fwdtransforms"][0], interpolator="genericLabel"
255    )
256
257    mytrim = 0 if m0_indices is not None else (n_to_trim or 0)
258    perf_total_sigma = 1.5
259    corrmo = timeseries_reg(
260        fmri,
261        fmri_template,
262        type_of_transform=type_of_transform,
263        total_sigma=perf_total_sigma,
264        fdOffset=2.0,
265        trim=mytrim,
266        output_directory=None,
267        verbose=verbose,
268        syn_metric="CC",
269        syn_sampling=2,
270        reg_iterations=[40, 20, 5],
271    )
272
273    if m0_image is not None:
274        m0 = m0_image
275    elif m0_indices is not None:
276        not_m0 = [x for x in range(fmri.shape[3]) if x not in m0_indices]
277        m0 = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(remove_volumes_from_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"], not_m0))
278        corrmo["motion_corrected"] = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"], m0_indices)
279        corrmo["FD"] = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(corrmo["FD"], m0_indices)
280        fmri = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(fmri, m0_indices)
281    else:
282        m0 = None
283
284    ntp = corrmo["motion_corrected"].shape[3]
285    tclist = _replicate_list(["C", "T"], ntp) if tc == "alternating" else _replicate_list(["C"], int(ntp / 2)) + _replicate_list(["T"], int(ntp / 2))
286    tclist_enc = _one_hot_encode(tclist[:ntp])
287
288    fmrimotcorr = corrmo["motion_corrected"]
289    hlinds = None
290    if 0.0 < outlier_threshold < 1.0:
291        fmrimotcorr, hlinds = loop_timeseries_censoring(fmrimotcorr, outlier_threshold, mask=None, verbose=verbose)
292        tclist_enc = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(tclist_enc, hlinds)
293        corrmo["FD"] = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(corrmo["FD"], hlinds)
294
295    fmri_template = ants.iMath(ants.get_average_of_timeseries(fmrimotcorr), "Normalize")
296    if upsample:
297        spc = ants.get_spacing(fmri)
298        minspc = min(2.0, min(spc[0:3]))
299        fmri_template = ants.resample_image(fmri_template, [minspc, minspc, minspc], interp_type=0)
300
301    rig = ants.registration(fmri_template, t1head, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]")
302    bmask = ants.apply_transforms(
303        fmri_template, ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 1, 6), rig["fwdtransforms"][0], interpolator="genericLabel"
304    )
305    warn_if_small_mask(bmask, label="bold_perfusion:bmask")
306
307    corrmo = timeseries_reg(
308        fmri,
309        fmri_template,
310        type_of_transform=type_of_transform,
311        total_sigma=perf_total_sigma,
312        fdOffset=2.0,
313        trim=mytrim,
314        output_directory=None,
315        verbose=verbose,
316        syn_metric="CC",
317        syn_sampling=2,
318        reg_iterations=[40, 20, 5],
319    )
320
321    if 0.0 < outlier_threshold < 1.0:
322        corrmo["motion_corrected"] = remove_volumes_from_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"], hlinds)
323        corrmo["FD"] = remove_elements_from_numpy_array(corrmo["FD"], hlinds)
324
325    mytsnr = tsnr(corrmo["motion_corrected"], bmask)
326    mytsnr_thresh = float(np.quantile(mytsnr.numpy(), 0.995))
327    tsnrmask = ants.threshold_image(mytsnr, 0, mytsnr_thresh).morphology("close", 3)
328    bmask = bmask * ants.iMath(tsnrmask, "FillHoles")
329    warn_if_small_mask(bmask, label="bold_perfusion:bmask*tsnrmask")
330
331    und = fmri_template * bmask
332    t1reg = ants.registration(und, t1, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[s]")
333    gmseg = (
334        ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 2, 2) + ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 4, 4)
335    ).threshold_image(1, 4).iMath("MD", 1)
336    gmseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, gmseg, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="genericLabel") * bmask
337
338    csfseg = ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 1, 1)
339    wmseg = ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 3, 3)
340    csf_and_wm = (csfseg + wmseg).morphology("erode", 1)
341    csf_and_wm = ants.apply_transforms(und, csf_and_wm, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor") * bmask
342    warn_if_small_mask(csf_and_wm, label="bold_perfusion:csfAndWM")
343
344    mycompcor = ants.compcor(corrmo["motion_corrected"], ncompcor=nc, quantile=0.50, mask=csf_and_wm, filter_type="polynomial", degree=2)
345    simg = ants.smooth_image(corrmo["motion_corrected"], spa, sigma_in_physical_coordinates=True)
346    nuisance = np.c_[mycompcor["basis"], mycompcor["components"]]
347    if add_FD_to_nuisance:
348        nuisance = np.c_[nuisance, corrmo["FD"]]
349    nuisance = ants.regress_components(nuisance, tclist_enc)
350
351    regression_mask = bmask.clone()
352    gmmat = ants.timeseries_to_matrix(simg, regression_mask)
353    regvars = np.hstack((nuisance, tclist_enc))
354    coefind = regvars.shape[1] - 1
355    regvars = regvars[:, range(coefind)]
356    predictor_idx = regvars.shape[1] - 1
357
358    if perfusion_regression_model == "linear":
359        model = LinearRegression()
360        model.fit(regvars, gmmat)
361        perfimg = ants.make_image(regression_mask, model.coef_[:, model.coef_.shape[1] - 1])
362    elif perfusion_regression_model in ["huber", "quantile", "theilsen", "ransac", "sgd"]:
363        models_map = {
364            "huber": HuberRegressor,
365            "quantile": QuantileRegressor,
366            "theilsen": TheilSenRegressor,
367            "ransac": RANSACRegressor,
368            "sgd": SGDRegressor,
369        }
370        scaler = StandardScaler()
371        gmmat_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(gmmat)
372        multi_model = MultiOutputRegressor(models_map[perfusion_regression_model]())
373        multi_model.fit(regvars, gmmat_scaled)
374        coeffs = np.array([est.coef_[predictor_idx] for est in multi_model.estimators_])
375        perfimg = ants.make_image(regression_mask, coeffs)
376    else:
377        raise ValueError(f"Unknown regression model: {perfusion_regression_model}")
378
379    meangmval = float((perfimg[gmseg == 1]).mean())
380    if meangmval < 0:
381        perfimg = perfimg * -1.0
382    negative_voxels = float((perfimg < 0.0).sum() / np.prod(perfimg.shape) * 100.0)
383    perfimg[perfimg < 0.0] = 0.0
384
385    if m0 is None:
386        m0 = ants.get_average_of_timeseries(corrmo["motion_corrected"])
387    else:
388        m0reg = ants.registration(fmri_template, m0, "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]", verbose=False)
389        m0 = m0reg["warpedmovout"]
390
391    if ntp == 2:
392        img0 = ants.slice_image(corrmo["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=0)
393        img1 = ants.slice_image(corrmo["motion_corrected"], axis=3, idx=1)
394        if m0_image is None and m0_indices is None:
395            perfimg, m0 = (img0, img1) if img0.mean() < img1.mean() else (img1, img0)
396        else:
397            perfimg = img1 - img0 if img0.mean() < img1.mean() else img0 - img1
398
399    cbf = calculate_CBF(Delta_M=perfimg, M_0=m0, mask=bmask)
400    if trim_the_mask > 0.0:
401        bmask = trim_dti_mask(cbf, bmask, trim_the_mask)
402        perfimg = perfimg * bmask
403        cbf = cbf * bmask
404
405    meangmval = float((perfimg[gmseg == 1]).mean())
406    meangmvalcbf = float((cbf[gmseg == 1]).mean())
407
408    rsf_nuisance = pd.DataFrame(nuisance)
409    rsf_nuisance["FD"] = corrmo["FD"]
410
411    dktseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, t1dktcit, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="genericLabel") * bmask
412    df_perf = antspyt1w.map_intensity_to_dataframe("dkt_cortex_cit_deep_brain", perfimg, dktseg)
413    df_perf = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format({"perf": df_perf}, col_names=["Mean"])
414
415    df_cbf = antspyt1w.map_intensity_to_dataframe("dkt_cortex_cit_deep_brain", cbf, dktseg)
416    df_cbf = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format({"cbf": df_cbf}, col_names=["Mean"]).add_prefix("cbf_")
417    df_perf_total = pd.concat([df_perf, df_cbf], axis=1, ignore_index=False)
418
419    return convert_np_in_dict({
420        "meanBold": und,
421        "brainmask": bmask,
422        "perfusion": perfimg,
423        "cbf": cbf,
424        "m0": m0,
425        "perfusion_gm_mean": meangmval,
426        "cbf_gm_mean": meangmvalcbf,
427        "perf_dataframe": df_perf_total,
428        "motion_corrected": corrmo["motion_corrected"],
429        "gmseg": gmseg,
430        "brain_mask": bmask,
431        "nuisance": rsf_nuisance,
432        "tsnr": mytsnr,
433        "ssnr": slice_snr(corrmo["motion_corrected"], csf_and_wm, gmseg),
434        "dvars": dvars(corrmo["motion_corrected"], gmseg),
435        "high_motion_count": int((rsf_nuisance["FD"] > FD_threshold).sum()),
436        "high_motion_pct": float((rsf_nuisance["FD"] > FD_threshold).sum() / rsf_nuisance.shape[0]),
437        "FD_max": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].max()),
438        "FD_mean": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].mean()),
439        "FD_sd": float(rsf_nuisance["FD"].std()),
440        "bold_evr": antspyt1w.patch_eigenvalue_ratio(und, 512, [16, 16, 16], evdepth=0.9, mask=bmask),
441        "t1reg": t1reg,
442        "outlier_volumes": hlinds,
443        "n_outliers": len(hlinds) if hlinds else 0,
444        "negative_voxels": negative_voxels,
445    })

Estimate perfusion and quantified CBF from a BOLD time series with anatomical guidance.

def pet3d_summary( pet3d: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1head: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1segmentation: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, t1dktcit: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, spa: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), type_of_transform: str = 'antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]', upsample: bool = True, verbose: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
12def pet3d_summary(
13    pet3d: ants.ANTsImage,
14    t1head: ants.ANTsImage,
15    t1: ants.ANTsImage,
16    t1segmentation: ants.ANTsImage,
17    t1dktcit: ants.ANTsImage,
18    spa: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
19    type_of_transform: str = "antsRegistrationSyNRepro[r]",
20    upsample: bool = True,
21    verbose: bool = False,
22) -> dict[str, Any]:
23    """Anatomical registration and DKT parcellation summary of 3D PET data."""
24    import antspyt1w
25
26    pet3dr = pet3d
27    if upsample:
28        spc = ants.get_spacing(pet3d)
29        minspc = min(1.0, min(spc))
30        pet3dr = ants.resample_image(pet3d, [minspc, minspc, minspc], interp_type=0)
31
32    rig = ants.registration(pet3dr, t1head, type_of_transform)
33    bmask = ants.apply_transforms(
34        pet3dr, ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 1, 6), rig["fwdtransforms"][0], interpolator="genericLabel"
35    )
36
37    und = pet3dr * bmask
38    t1reg = rig
39    gmseg = (
40        ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 2, 2) + ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 4, 4)
41    ).threshold_image(1, 4).iMath("MD", 1)
42    gmseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, gmseg, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="genericLabel") * bmask
43
44    csfseg = ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 1, 1)
45    wmseg = ants.threshold_image(t1segmentation, 3, 3)
46    csf_and_wm = (csfseg + wmseg).morphology("erode", 1)
47    csf_and_wm = ants.apply_transforms(und, csf_and_wm, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor") * bmask
48    csfseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, csfseg, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor") * bmask
49    wmseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, wmseg, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="nearestNeighbor") * bmask
50
51    wmsignal = float(pet3dr[ants.iMath(wmseg, "ME", 1) == 1].mean())
52    gmsignal = float(pet3dr[gmseg == 1].mean())
53    csfsignal = float(pet3dr[csfseg == 1].mean())
54
55    dktseg = ants.apply_transforms(und, t1dktcit, t1reg["fwdtransforms"], interpolator="genericLabel") * bmask
56    df_pet3d = antspyt1w.map_intensity_to_dataframe("dkt_cortex_cit_deep_brain", und, dktseg)
57    df_pet3d = antspyt1w.merge_hierarchical_csvs_to_wide_format({"pet3d": df_pet3d}, col_names=["Mean"])
58
59    return convert_np_in_dict({
60        "pet3d_dataframe": df_pet3d,
61        "pet3d": pet3dr,
62        "brainmask": bmask,
63        "gm_mean": gmsignal,
64        "wm_mean": wmsignal,
65        "csf_mean": csfsignal,
66    })

Anatomical registration and DKT parcellation summary of 3D PET data.

def down2iso( x: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, interpolation: str = 'linear', takemin: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
 9def down2iso(
10    x: ants.ANTsImage,
11    interpolation: str = "linear",
12    takemin: bool = False,
13) -> ants.ANTsImage:
14    """Downsample an anisotropic image to an isotropic resolution."""
15    spc = ants.get_spacing(x)
16    if takemin:
17        newspc = np.asarray(spc).min()
18    else:
19        newspc = np.asarray(spc).max()
20    newspc_arr = np.repeat(newspc, x.dimension)
21    if interpolation == "linear":
22        return ants.resample_image(x, newspc_arr, interp_type=0)
23    return ants.resample_image(x, newspc_arr, interp_type=1)

Downsample an anisotropic image to an isotropic resolution.

def super_res_mcimage( image: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, srmodel: Any, truncation: list[float] | None = None, poly_order: str | int | None = 'hist', target_range: list[float] | tuple[float, float] | None = None, isotropic: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
26def super_res_mcimage(
27    image: ants.ANTsImage,
28    srmodel: Any,
29    truncation: list[float] | None = None,
30    poly_order: str | int | None = "hist",
31    target_range: list[float] | tuple[float, float] | None = None,
32    isotropic: bool = False,
33    verbose: bool = False,
34) -> ants.ANTsImage:
35    """Super resolution on a timeseries or multi-channel image."""
36    import antspynet
37
38    if truncation is None:
39        truncation = [0.0001, 0.995]
40    if target_range is None:
41        target_range = [0, 1]
42
43    idim = image.dimension
44    ishape = image.shape
45    n_time_points = ishape[idim - 1]
46    mcsr: list[ants.ANTsImage] = []
47    mysr: ants.ANTsImage | None = None
48
49    for k in range(n_time_points):
50        if verbose and ((k % 5) == 0):
51            mycount = round(k / n_time_points * 100)
52            print(f"{mycount}%.", end="", flush=True)
53        temp = ants.slice_image(image, axis=idim - 1, idx=k)
54        temp = ants.iMath(temp, "TruncateIntensity", truncation[0], truncation[1])
55        mysr = antspynet.apply_super_resolution_model_to_image(
56            temp, srmodel, target_range=target_range
57        )
58        if poly_order is not None:
59            bilin = ants.resample_image_to_target(temp, mysr)
60            if poly_order == "hist":
61                mysr = ants.histogram_match_image(mysr, bilin)
62            else:
63                mysr = ants.regression_match_image(mysr, bilin, poly_order=poly_order)
64        if isotropic:
65            mysr = down2iso(mysr)
66        mcsr.append(mysr)
67
68    if mysr is None:
69        raise ValueError("Cannot super-resolve empty time series.")
70
71    upshape: list[int] = [mysr.shape[j] for j in range(len(ishape) - 1)]
72    upshape.append(ishape[idim - 1])
73    if verbose:
74        print(f"SR will be of voxel size: {upshape}")
75
76    imageup = ants.resample_image(image, upshape, use_voxels=True)
77    if verbose:
78        print("Done")
79
80    return ants.list_to_ndimage(imageup, mcsr)

Super resolution on a timeseries or multi-channel image.

def t1w_super_resolution_with_hemispheres( t1img: ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage, model: Any, dilation_amount: int = 8, truncation: list[float] | None = None, target_range: list[float] | None = None, poly_order: str | int = 'hist', min_spacing: float = 0.8, verbose: bool = True) -> ants.core.ants_image.ANTsImage: 
 83def t1w_super_resolution_with_hemispheres(
 84    t1img: ants.ANTsImage,
 85    model: Any,
 86    dilation_amount: int = 8,
 87    truncation: list[float] | None = None,
 88    target_range: list[float] | None = None,
 89    poly_order: str | int = "hist",
 90    min_spacing: float = 0.8,
 91    verbose: bool = True,
 92) -> ants.ANTsImage:
 93    """Perform hemisphere-aware super-resolution on a T1-weighted image."""
 94    import antspynet
 95    import antspyt1w
 96    import siq
 97
 98    if truncation is None:
 99        truncation = [0.001, 0.999]
100    if target_range is None:
101        target_range = [0, 1]
102    if float(np.min(ants.get_spacing(t1img))) < min_spacing:
103        if verbose:
104            print("Image resolution too high — skipping SR.")
105        return t1img
106
107    if verbose:
108        print("Performing brain extraction...")
109    brain_mask = antspyt1w.brain_extraction(t1img)
110    brain = t1img * brain_mask
111
112    if verbose:
113        print("Begin template loading")
114    tlrfn = antspyt1w.get_data("T_template0_LR", target_extension=".nii.gz")
115    tfn = antspyt1w.get_data("T_template0", target_extension=".nii.gz")
116    template = ants.image_read(tfn)
117    template = (template * antspynet.brain_extraction(template, "t1")).iMath("Normalize")
118    template_lr = ants.image_read(tlrfn)
119    if verbose:
120        print("Done template loading")
121
122    if verbose:
123        print("Labeling hemispheres...")
124    hemi_seg = antspyt1w.label_hemispheres(brain, template, template_lr)
125    hemisphere_mask = hemi_seg + 2.0 * brain_mask
126
127    if verbose:
128        print("Starting segmentation-aware super-resolution...")
129    sr_result = siq.inference(
130        t1img,
131        model,
132        segmentation=hemisphere_mask,
133        truncation=truncation,
134        target_range=target_range,
135        dilation_amount=dilation_amount,
136        poly_order=poly_order,
137        verbose=verbose,
138    )
139
140    sr_image = sr_result["super_resolution"] if isinstance(sr_result, dict) else sr_result
141    if verbose:
142        print("Done super-resolution.")
143    return sr_image

Perform hemisphere-aware super-resolution on a T1-weighted image.
